title: Amazon Fba product sourcer (Online arbitrage, Wholesale arbitrage)
description:
Looking for an experienced Amazon FBA sourcer to find profitable online 

arbitrage leads for our store. Must already be comfortable with SellerAmp 

and Keepa — this is not an entry-level/training role.



Hours: 25 hours/week required

Pay: Flat weekly rate (based on experience — mention your rate expectations 

when applying)

Quota: Minimum 5-10 vetted leads per day, logged in our shared Google Sheet

Reporting: Google Sheet must be updated daily — no batching leads to dump 

at the end of the week

Performance: Repeated missed quotas or unreported days will result in a 

warning, then pay adjustment, then termination if it continues



What you'll do:

- Reverse source: go through other sellers' storefronts on Amazon to find 

 what they're selling, then locate that same product cheaper from the 

 retailer/website they likely sourced it from

- Vet every lead using Keepa (price history, sales rank history, seller 

 count over time) and SellerAmp (ROI, fees, profitability, eligibility)

- Check BSR (Best Seller Rank) against category requirements to confirm 

 it's a fast enough mover before submitting a lead

- Confirm eligibility/ungating status on each ASIN before adding it to 

 the list — don't submit gated items unless already approved

- Flag any IP complaint risk, hazmat, or restricted brand issues

- Update the shared Google Sheet daily with: product name, buy link, cost, 

 sell price, ROI %, BSR, and eligibility status for every lead found

- OFFER COUNT MUST BE LOW



What you need to already know:

-We are gated on lots of products due to us being a new seller

- SellerAmp (SAS) — pulling ROI/profitability and running eligibility checks

- Keepa — reading price/rank history charts, spotting stable vs. volatile 

 listings

- Reverse sourcing / storefront stalking methodology

- What BSR ranges are actually sourceable per category (not just "low 

 number = good")

- Amazon's restricted categories, gated brands, and common IP-risk red 

 flags



Access provided:

- Your own restricted Seller Central login (Inventory access only — no 

 orders, payments, or financial data)

- Shared SellerAmp login for research

- Shared Google Sheet for daily lead logging

- You will connect YOUR OWN Seller Central login inside SellerAmp when 

 prompted — do not use any other login



To apply: send 2-3 sample leads with your reasoning (Keepa chart read, 

ROI calc, why you picked it). Shortlisted applicants will hop on a call 

to be interviewed before final hire.

title: Senior Fulfilment and Last Mile Operations Manager
description:
Remote | Full-time



Make the daily decisions that keep deliveries moving, warehouse capacity under control and transport costs balanced.



We are looking for an experienced fulfilment and last mile operations professional to take ownership of the flow of customer orders from our warehouses through to final delivery.



This is a senior, hands-on role with a strong focus on operational judgement. You’ll work closely with the Fulfillment team lead, our warehouse, customer service and transport partners to make practical decisions that balance customer commitments, available space, delivery capacity and cost.



You’ll need to see the whole picture. Sometimes bringing stock forward protects a customer delivery date. Other times, consolidating a linehaul movement makes better commercial sense, or moving stock sooner is necessary to free up warehouse space and keep orders flowing. Your role is to weigh the trade-offs, make the call and ensure the teams involved follow through.



What you’ll be responsible for:



Daily fulfilment decisions: Set priorities across picking, dispatch, stock transfers and delivery, taking account of order readiness, capacity and customer commitments.



Warehouse capacity and stock flow: Work with warehouse leaders to manage space constraints, inbound arrivals and outbound volumes, preventing congestion and unnecessary handling.



Linehaul planning: Balance transfer timing, load utilization and transport costs against stock availability and warehouse capacity.



Last mile delivery: Manage courier and delivery partner performance, bookings, service standards and delivery exceptions.



Customer outcomes: Work with customer service to identify delivery risks early, agree realistic solutions and ensure customers receive clear updates.



Exception management: Resolve competing priorities, delayed movements, failed deliveries and urgent orders, understanding the wider impact of each decision.



Commercial performance: Monitor cost per delivery, linehaul utilisation, redelivery costs and other controllable expenses, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.



Team coordination: Give clear direction, establish ownership and hold internal teams and external partners accountable for agreed actions.



Back office Admin: Leading our back office admin team who liaises with locally based suppliers, will also form part of this positions' remit.



Continuous improvement: Strengthen processes, reporting and systems so the operation becomes more reliable and easier to manage.



You’ll also step into the operation when needed—investigating an issue on the warehouse floor, checking an order or helping the team through a peak period.



What you’ll bring

Strong experience in fulfilment, transport or last mile operations, ideally within furniture, bulky goods, retail or a similar delivery environment.



Experience coordinating warehouses, interstate linehaul movements and external delivery partners.



The ability to make sound decisions when priorities compete and information is incomplete.



Commercial awareness: you understand how delivery promises, stock movements, storage constraints and transport choices affect cost and service.



Confidence using operational data and warehouse, ERP and delivery systems to identify issues and guide decisions.



Clear communication and the ability to work effectively with warehouse teams, customer service, suppliers and senior management.



A practical approach, strong follow-through and a willingness to get involved when needed.



What success looks like



Customer orders move predictably from warehouse to delivery. Stock transfers are planned with both capacity and cost in mind. Delivery risks are identified early, avoidable costs are reduced, and everyone involved understands the priorities and their responsibilities.

We specialise in Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, website development and digital marketing strategy.



We're looking for a motivated Digital Marketing Specialist to join our growing team. Someone who knows their way around digital advertising, enjoys getting stuck into campaigns and wants to develop their skills within an ambitious agency.

You'll work across a range of client accounts, helping plan, execute, manage and optimise digital marketing campaigns.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Setting up, managing and optimising Google Ads campaigns.

- Managing and improving campaign performance to generate quality leads for clients.

- Assisting with social media marketing (SMM) strategies and execution.

- Working across Meta and other social media advertising platforms.

- Monitoring campaign performance, identifying opportunities and making data-driven recommendations.

- Preparing campaign reports and communicating performance updates.

- Working closely with the wider team to deliver results for clients.

- Identifying problems, finding solutions and continuously looking for ways to improve campaign performance.



Must-Have Experience & Skills



We're looking for someone who has:



- At least 2 years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns for local businesses.

- A strong understanding of social media marketing (SMM), including content, strategy and paid social.

- Previous experience working within a digital marketing agency.

- A solid understanding of lead generation and what drives results for local businesses.

- The ability to analyse campaign performance and make informed optimisation decisions.

- Good written and verbal communication skills.



The Person We're Looking For



Technical skills are important, but the right attitude is just as important.



You'll ideally be someone who is:



- Hardworking: Takes pride in their work and isn't afraid to put in the effort.

- Reliable: Follows through on commitments, meets deadlines and takes ownership.

- A good communicator: Can communicate clearly with clients and team members.

- A problem solver: Doesn't just identify problems. Looks for solutions and takes initiative.

- Growth-minded: Always looking to learn, improve and develop professionally.

- Proactive: Doesn't need to be constantly chased or told what to do.

We're building an agency with big ambitions, and we want people who want to grow with us.

- Work with a growing portfolio of Australian businesses across different industries.

- Develop your skills across Google Ads, Meta Ads and broader digital marketing.

We're hiring a dedicated writer for a long-term, high-volume content project with Equity Connect. This is steady, ongoing work — the amount of articles is unlimited, and strong writers will have as much work as they can handle, every week, indefinitely.



We're especially looking for editors and proofreaders who also write — people who catch small errors, enforce style guides, and care about consistency across every sentence.



What the work looks like:



You'll receive a complete brief (outline) and a set of writing rules for every article. Your job is research and writing — nothing else. No pitching topics, no guessing what we want. The brief tells you the structure, and the guidelines tell you the style: tone, sentence structure, vocabulary, expressions to use, and words to avoid.



This job rewards precision, not creativity. If you're the kind of writer who enjoys following a clear system and getting it exactly right, you'll do very well here. If you prefer creative freedom, this isn't your project.



If you already think in house style, tone rules, and "words to avoid," you'll pick up our guidelines quickly.



Important — this is 100% manual writing:



AI-generated or AI-assisted drafts are not accepted. All drafts are checked with AI-detection tools and writing-behavior monitoring. Submissions that fail these checks end the contract — no exceptions. If you write everything yourself, none of this will ever be an issue for you.



Workload (once hired):



We hire both full-time and part-time writers. Full-time writers are able to write 2-3 articles per day. For part-time writers, 1 article every 1-2 days is realistic.



Pay:



$0.010 USD per word for months 0-6, for every successful article completed.

$0.015 USD per word for months 7-18, for every successful article completed.

$0.020 USD per word for months 18+, for every successful article completed.



Because volume is unlimited, your monthly income is set by your own output. Writers who master our system once can produce quickly and consistently — the guidelines feel dense on your first article and become second nature by your third.



Payments:



- Pay period is Monday–Sunday

- Payments are initiated on Mondays for the previous week's work

- Payments via Pioneer or Wise

- There are no paid holidays



Turnaround:



Fast delivery matters. Same-day or next-day turnaround per article is the expectation once you're up to speed.

 your results to

title: Illustrator Production Assistant (Adobe Illustrator) – 5-Day Trial Gig
description:
About us

We’re a small brand making custom family portraits, little hand-drawn faces that look like your actual people. Right now we have a pile of orders and need an extra set of eyes and hands.



What you’ll do

Look at customer photos and match each person to the closest illustration from our existing library of portrait faces

When there’s no exact match, edit an existing portrait in Adobe Illustrator to fit (hairstyle, glasses, facial hair, etc.)

Mostly production work with light editing. You won’t be drawing from scratch.



The gig

Short-term trial, this week only

Estimated 10-40 hours over the next 5-7 days

If it goes well and you’re fast and accurate, it could turn into ongoing work

Paid via Wise at the end of the gig



You should have:

Working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator (selecting, moving, and editing existing vector shapes is the main skill)

An ability to match brand style.

Access to Adobe Illustrator already.

A good eye for small details, like whether someone has bangs, a part, a ponytail, or round vs. square glasses

Reliable internet and the ability to hit a tight turnaround

Good communication. If something’s unclear, ask us instead of guessing.



To apply, reply with:

1. Your hourly rate

2. The hours you can work in EST time this week

3. Are you able to work 8pm-10pm GMT+8 TODAY for initial training and overlap, in which we would communicate in real time over Google chat?

4.  A short test: look at the 2 family photos attached. Using the character sheet, which illustrations would you pick to match each person? 
 Please circle your picks on the sheet (blue for right family, red for left family) and send it back to us.



Applications without the circled test won’t be considered. It’s quick, and it’s the best way for us to see how you see.

title: Marketplace & E-commerce Specialist (Philippines)
description:
We are an established Australian business with a portfolio of home fragrance, lifestyle and DIY fragrance brands, expanding into the Philippines market.

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Marketplace & E-commerce Specialist to launch, manage and grow our brands across Shopee, TikTok Shop, Shopify and Lazada.

This is an opportunity to build our Philippine e-commerce presence from the ground up, taking ownership of marketplace operations, advertising, sales performance and ongoing growth.

Key Responsibilities

• Marketplace Launch & Management: Set up, launch and manage branded stores across Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop, including seller onboarding, store configuration and ongoing optimisation.

• Product & Catalogue Management: Manage product listings, pricing, promotions, inventory accuracy and product content across platforms.

• Marketplace Advertising: Plan, execute and optimise Shopee Ads, Lazada Sponsored Solutions and TikTok Shop advertising to drive profitable sales.

• Sales & Promotional Planning: Develop promotional calendars, manage vouchers and discounts, and participate in key marketplace sales events.

• E-commerce Operations: Coordinate order processing, fulfilment, stock management, customer service and returns with our internal teams and logistics partners.

• Shopify Management: Support the setup and ongoing management of our Philippine Shopify store, including product listings, merchandising and promotions.

• Performance & Growth: Monitor sales, advertising spend, ROAS, conversion rates and profitability, providing regular reporting and recommendations.

• Local Market Insights: Monitor competitors, pricing, customer trends and marketplace opportunities to identify growth opportunities.

Required Experience & Skills

• Minimum 3 years' hands-on experience managing Philippine e-commerce marketplaces.

• Strong working knowledge of Shopee Seller Centre, Lazada Seller Center and TikTok Shop Seller Center.

• Proven experience launching and growing marketplace stores, ideally from initial setup.

• Practical experience managing marketplace advertising campaigns and promotional budgets.

• Good working knowledge of Shopify and e-commerce operations.

• Experience coordinating inventory, fulfilment, customer enquiries and returns.

• Strong analytical skills with an understanding of ROAS, conversion rates, sales performance and profitability.

• Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and written English.

• Proactive, commercially minded and comfortable working independently.

Highly Regarded

• Experience in beauty, home fragrance, personal care, lifestyle or consumer products.

• TikTok Shop affiliate marketing, creator collaborations and live-selling campaigns.

• Experience with multichannel inventory tools such as Ginee or BigSeller.

• Experience launching new brands or products into the Philippine market.

About the Role

This is a full-time, remote position (40 hours per week), working closely with our Australian marketing team and existing Philippines-based team.

You will be responsible for establishing and growing our local e-commerce business across multiple brands, with support from our internal marketing, design and operations teams.

We are looking for someone who combines commercial thinking with hands-on execution, takes initiative and is genuinely motivated to grow a business.



When you apply, please include:

1. A brief summary of your experience with Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop and Shopify.

2. Examples of marketplace stores you have personally launched or managed.

3. Your experience managing marketplace advertising and promotional campaigns.

4. A specific example of how you have grown marketplace sales or improved profitability.

5. Your expected hourly rate in USD and availability to commence.

6. Include your resume

s and opportunities.

title: AU Senior Accountant / Tax Reviewer & Team Leader
description:
Capita Business Advisors and Tax Consultants is an established Australian accounting, taxation and business advisory practice expanding our Philippines-based team.



We are seeking an experienced AU Senior Accountant / Tax Reviewer & Team Leader with strong Australian public-practice experience and proven technical review and leadership capabilities.



This is a senior technical and supervisory position, not a routine tax preparation or data-entry role. The successful candidate must independently review accounting and taxation work, identify errors and compliance risks, supervise staff, manage deadlines and prepare complex work when required.



You will work closely with the Principal Accountant in Australia, ensuring high-quality work, accountability and continuous process improvement.



Key Responsibilities



- Independently prepare and review Australian financial statements and income tax returns for companies, trusts, partnerships and individuals.

- Apply strong technical knowledge of Australian taxation, including CGT, Division 7A, trust distributions, GST/BAS/IAS, depreciation and director/shareholder loan accounts.

- Prepare and review financial reports in accordance with applicable Australian Accounting Standards (AASB).

- Critically review accounting, bookkeeping, payroll, superannuation, balance-sheet reconciliations and supporting workpapers, identifying errors and ensuring corrections are completed.

- Undertake hands-on accounting, bookkeeping and reconciliations when required, including transactions involving e-commerce and payment platforms.

- Supervise accountants and bookkeepers, delegate tasks, monitor deadlines, provide review notes and ensure timely completion of work.

- Communicate directly with Australian clients and follow up outstanding information, accounting queries and compliance matters.

- Prepare and review management accounts, budgets, cash-flow forecasts, actual-versus-budget reports and variance analysis, providing meaningful financial insights.

- Mentor team members and improve accounting procedures, workflows, quality control and review processes.

- Use Xero, MYOB, Excel, AI and other accounting technologies effectively while maintaining professional judgement and confidentiality.

- Work closely with the Principal Accountant in Australia on complex technical matters, client issues, workflow management and practice development.

- Support the future growth of the Philippines team, including recruitment, training, systems implementation and potential office establishment.

- Be available for occasional international business travel, including Australia, when reasonably required.





What we are looking for



Minimum five years of hands-on Australian public-practice accounting and taxation experience, including proven experience independently reviewing financial statements, income tax returns and workpapers prepared by other accountants.



Accounting or related degree; CPA, CA or equivalent professional qualification highly regarded.



Strong practical knowledge of Australian taxation, including company and trust taxation, Division 7A, CGT, GST, depreciation and trust distributions.



Demonstrated ability to independently prepare and critically review company, trust, partnership and individual income tax returns, identifying errors, compliance risks and matters requiring further investigation.



Sound knowledge of Australian Accounting Standards (AASB), financial statement preparation, year-end adjustments and tax reconciliations.



Proven experience reviewing bookkeeping, balance-sheet reconciliations, financial statements and tax work, providing clear review notes and ensuring identified issues are satisfactorily resolved.



Strong proficiency in Xero and Australian tax preparation software. Experience with Xero Tax, Xero Practice Manager (XPM) and MYOB will be highly regarded.



Strong Excel skills, with experience in management reporting, budgeting, cash-flow forecasting and variance analysis considered an advantage.



Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to communicate directly with Australian clients and explain accounting and taxation matters professionally.



Demonstrated leadership and organisational skills, including the ability to delegate tasks, supervise junior accountants, monitor deadlines and follow up outstanding matters with staff and clients.



Strong technical judgement, attention to detail and the ability to distinguish between routine corrections and complex matters requiring escalation to the Principal Accountant.



A proactive, accountable and hands-on approach, with the ability to manage assigned work independently while assisting with accounting, bookkeeping, reconciliations and tax preparation when required.



Working Arrangement & Growth



The role will initially be remote and based in the Philippines.

As our Philippines operation grows, we may develop an office-based or hybrid team structure. The successful candidate may also take on broader leadership and operational responsibilities over time, with remuneration reviewed accordingly.



Recruitment Process



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid practical Australian accounting and taxation assessment before the final interview.



The assessment will focus on reviewing accounting records, reconciliations, financial statements, tax returns and supporting workpapers. Candidates will be expected to identify errors, provide review notes and demonstrate their ability to resolve issues or escalate complex matters appropriately.



This assessment is designed to evaluate practical experience, technical expertise, independent review capabilities, professional judgement and attention to detail.



Direct Applicants Only



We welcome applications from qualified individuals seeking a long-term career opportunity with our practice. We recruit directly and do not consider applications from recruitment agencies, outsourcing or staffing providers, subcontractors or third-party representatives.



All applicants are expected to participate personally in the recruitment process and complete their assessments independently.

title: Real Estate VP Technology Strategy and Innovation
description:
Reports to CEO and President

Works closely with the VP of Technology Operations and Systems Integration and Lead Management team; Operations; Agent Services; Marketing; Compliance; Finance; and external technology partners



Position Overview

YLN is creating this role to own both technology direction and portfolio delivery for its next stage of growth. The VP will translate the 2027 growth plan into an executable roadmap for platforms, data, AI, automation, security, staffing, and

investment. The role is accountable for priorities, capacity decisions, delivery commitments, and measurable business

results across the technology portfolio.



Role Distinction

This role has final accountability for enterprise technology priorities and delivery outcomes. Within approved budgets and

executive direction, the VP sets the roadmap, target architecture, sequence, deadlines, and capacity requirements. Zohaib

directs the team's daily work and assigns resources to approved priorities. When demand exceeds capacity, Zohaib

presents the constraint and options; this VP d
 what moves, what pauses, and what staffing is needed, escalating

budget or headcount decisions to the CEO and President.



Core Responsibilities and Area Accountability

1. 2027 Growth Roadmap - Own a multi-year roadmap tied to growth and revenue goals, with named owners, deadlines, dependencies, capacity, and staffing assumptions. Review delivery performance regularly and make timely priority or resource decisions when commitments are at risk.

2. Scalable Technology Stack - Own target architecture across Zillow Pro, Follow Up Boss, Ylopo, eRelocation, Biloco, and future tools. Before approval, assess effects on other departments, existing workflows, reporting, permissions, costs, support, and the agent and client experience.

3. AI and Automation - Work with department leaders to identify high-burden manual processes and prioritize practical AI or automation. Define the baseline, expected benefit, controls, owner, and adoption plan; check back after launch to confirm the change solved the problem.

4. Data Quality and Analytics - Own data definitions, reporting requirements, executive dashboards, and reporting priorities. Set standards and accountability for accurate, timely reports; use results to guide routing, nurture, staffing, and investment decisions while Zohaib owns report production and delivery.

5. Agent and Client Growth - Design technology that strengthens onboarding, partner service, agent productivity, and retention. Involve affected teams before changes are made, plan training and support, and validate afterward that workflows and the agent or client experience improved.

6. Vendor Governance and Budget - Own platform selection, contracts, strategic vendor calls, technology budget, licensing

policy, service levels, security, and vendor risk. Maintain accountability for technology spend and billing controls; Zohaib manages support calls, usage records, and invoice validation.

7. Cross Functional Leadership - Set portfolio priorities and delivery standards, direct work through the approved roadmap,

and hold leaders accountable for commitments. Lead impact reviews with Operations, Agent Services, Marketing, Compliance, Finance, and other teams before and after material changes.



Qualifications

• Senior technology leadership experience in a growing, lead-driven organization, with accountability for strategy,

architecture, budgets, staffing, vendors, and delivery results.

• Demonstrated success with CRM, marketing technology, multi-client environments, and API-based integrations;

experience with Follow Up Boss, Zillow, Ylopo, or eRelocation is strongly preferred.

• Practical experience deploying AI and automation with baselines, controls, adoption plans, and measurable results.

• Strong command of data governance, reporting, analytics, cybersecurity, privacy, access management, and change

governance.

• Clear executive communication and the ability to resolve competing priorities, capacity constraints, and cross-functional

impacts.

• Real estate, relocation, mortgage, or agent-network experience is preferred. A bachelor's degree in technology,

business, or a related field, or equivalent experience, is expected.

Success Measures

• A prioritized 2027 roadmap is actively managed with owners, deadlines, capacity, staffing assumptions, and clear

escalation paths.

• Portfolio commitments are delivered predictably, and capacity conflicts are resolved through explicit reprioritization,

staffing, or executive decisions.

• At least one high-burden manual process is improved within 90 days, with a documented baseline and measurable

result.

• Affected departments confirm that material changes improve workflows, reporting, permissions, or the agent and client

experience.

• Executive and recurring reports have defined owners, standards, schedules, and reliable source data.

• Technology vendors, contracts, billing, licensing, security, and access risks are reviewed on schedule and acted upon.

title: Administrative Data & Compliance Assistant
description:
ADMINISTRATIVE DATA & COMPLIANCE ASSISTANT



Company: Free Life Wellness Center

Schedule: Full-Time, 40 Hours/Week

Location: Remote

Primary Support: Compliance & Scheduling Departments



♦️ ABOUT THE ROLE



Free Life Wellness Center is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and dependable Administrative Data & Compliance Assistant to provide support across two important areas of our organization: Compliance and Scheduling.



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position generally divided as follows:



✅ 20 Hours/Week – Compliance Data Entry & Administrative Support



✅ 20 Hours/Week – Scheduling Data Entry & Administrative Support



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, spreadsheets, systems,
, documentation, and detailed administrative processes.



Accuracy is extremely important. You will help ensure information received through our inboxes, systems, and internal processes is entered correctly, kept current, organized appropriately, and routed to the correct team members.



Previous experience in healthcare or behavioral health and an understanding of HIPAA and patient/client confidentiality are strongly preferred.



♦️ COMPLIANCE SUPPORT – APPROXIMATELY 20 HOURS/WEEK



Working with our compliance leadership, responsibilities may include:



✅ Complete compliance-related data entry.



✅ Update and maintain compliance spreadsheets, trackers, logs, and reports.



✅ Enter information from documents,
s, reports, and internal systems accurately.



✅ Review assigned trackers for missing, incomplete, or outdated information.



✅ Assist with tracking documentation requirements, compliance requirements, deadlines, and outstanding items.



✅ Maintain organized electronic compliance files.



✅ Assist with preparing information and supporting documentation for internal reviews and audits.



✅ Update compliance information as directed by leadership.



✅ Identify missing or conflicting information and communicate discrepancies to the appropriate team member.



✅ Complete routine administrative follow-up regarding outstanding compliance items.



✅ Help ensure compliance trackers remain current and accurate.



✅ Maintain confidentiality when handling client, employee, provider, or organizational information.



This position supports the compliance process through data entry, tracking, organization, and follow-up. Compliance decisions and oversight remain with compliance leadership.



♦️ SCHEDULING & DATA ENTRY SUPPORT – APPROXIMATELY 20 HOURS/WEEK



Working alongside our Scheduler, responsibilities may include:



✅ Monitor assigned scheduling-related inboxes and communications.



✅ Review incoming
s and ensure relevant information is entered accurately into the appropriate scheduling system, tracker, or workflow.



✅ Enter new client and scheduling information.



✅ Update appointment changes, cancellations, provider availability, client availability, and other scheduling information as assigned.



✅ Verify that information entered into the system matches the original
 or source.



✅ Assist with maintaining accurate scheduling spreadsheets and trackers.



✅ Identify missing or incomplete scheduling information.



✅ Route questions or situations requiring a scheduling decision to the Scheduler.



✅ Assist with organizing scheduling
s and administrative requests.



✅ Complete routine data cleanup and review records for accuracy.



✅ Help ensure information received through the scheduling inbox does not get missed or remain unprocessed.



The Scheduler remains responsible for scheduling decisions, coordination, and oversight. This position supports the scheduling process by ensuring information is entered, updated, organized, and processed accurately.



♦️ ACCURACY & QUALITY EXPECTATIONS



Accuracy is one of the most important responsibilities of this position.



You will be expected to:



✅ Double-check information before submitting or saving it.



✅ Compare entered information against the original source.



✅ Pay close attention to names, dates, times, providers, services, and other details.



✅ Never guess when information is unclear, missing, or conflicting.



✅ Ask questions when clarification is needed.



✅ Identify and communicate discrepancies.



✅ Correct identified errors promptly.



✅ Keep assigned inboxes, trackers, and work queues organized.



✅ Complete assigned data entry within established timelines.



✅ Follow established workflows and written procedures consistently.



✅ Maintain confidentiality and follow all company privacy and security requirements.



♦️ MUST-HAVES



✅ Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.



✅ Strong data-entry and organizational skills.



✅ Excellent written English and reading comprehension.



✅ Reliable and consistent attendance.



✅ Strong ability to follow detailed written instructions and established processes.



✅ Comfortable working with spreadsheets, trackers, inboxes, and large amounts of information.



✅ Strong Google Workspace skills, particularly Gmail, Google Sheets, Google Docs, and Google Drive.



✅ Ability to learn new software, electronic systems, and workflows quickly.



✅ Comfortable performing repetitive administrative tasks while maintaining a high level of accuracy.



✅ Able to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.



✅ Able to recognize missing, conflicting, or unclear information and ask questions rather than making assumptions.



✅ Professional and able to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately.



✅ Willing and able to complete required HIPAA, privacy, security, and organizational compliance training.



✅ Reliable high-speed internet.



✅ Private and secure workspace appropriate for handling confidential healthcare information.



♦️ STRONGLY PREFERRED



🔹 Previous experience working in healthcare, behavioral health, medical administration, or a similar healthcare environment.



🔹 Understanding of HIPAA, patient/client confidentiality, and protected health information (PHI).



🔹 Experience working with electronic health record (EHR) or electronic medical record (EMR) systems.



🔹 Experience with healthcare scheduling, referrals, authorizations, eligibility, or other client/patient administrative processes.



🔹 Previous compliance, quality-management, or healthcare data-entry experience.



🔹 Experience maintaining compliance trackers, spreadsheets, logs, or audit-related information.



🔹 Experience managing shared healthcare or administrative inboxes.



🔹 Previous scheduling experience.



🔹 Previous remote administrative or data-entry experience.



♦️ CONFIDENTIALITY & HIPAA EXPECTATIONS



Because this position may work with client information, scheduling information, documentation, employee information, and other protected or confidential information, maintaining privacy and confidentiality is essential.



You will be expected to:



✅ Follow Free Life Wellness Center's HIPAA, privacy, security, and confidentiality policies.



✅ Access client and employee information only when necessary to perform assigned job duties.



✅ Protect usernames, passwords, and system access.



✅ Work from a private and secure environment.



✅ Use only company-approved systems and communication methods when handling protected information.



✅ Never download, save, print, photograph, or share protected information outside of approved company systems.



✅ Immediately report potential privacy, security, or data-entry concerns according to company procedures.



✅ Complete all required HIPAA, privacy, security, and compliance training.



♦️ WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



A successful person in this position will:



✅ Keep assigned compliance trackers accurate and current.



✅ Complete data entry consistently and on time.



✅ Catch errors, discrepancies, and missing information before they become larger problems.



✅ Keep scheduling information from the inbox accurately reflected in the appropriate systems.



✅ Ensure incoming scheduling information is processed rather than sitting unaddressed in the inbox.



✅ Reduce routine data-entry responsibilities for our Scheduler and compliance leadership.



✅ Keep assigned inboxes, trackers, and work queues organized.



✅ Communicate quickly when information is unclear or incomplete.



✅ Follow established procedures without needing repeated reminders.



✅ Require minimal follow-up once trained on a process.



✅ Maintain confidentiality and demonstrate good judgment when working with sensitive information.



✅ Be known for accuracy, reliability, organization, and consistency.



♦️ THE GOAL OF THIS POSITION



The goal of this position is to give our Scheduling and Compliance teams additional administrative capacity.



This person will help ensure information coming into Free Life is entered accurately, trackers remain current, administrative tasks are completed, and important information does not fall through the cracks.



Our Scheduler should have more time to focus on scheduling, coordination, and problem-solving rather than routine data entry.



Our compliance leadership should have more time to focus on compliance oversight, quality, review, and decision-making rather than routine administrative updates.



This position plays an important behind-the-scenes role in helping Free Life Wellness Center stay organized, accurate, compliant, and responsive.



♦️ COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



✅ Starting Rate: $5.00 USD/hour



✅ Hours: 40 hours per week



✅ Payment: Bi-weekly through our payroll provider



✅ Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Arizona Time



✅ Breaks: 1-hour unpaid lunch and two 15-minute paid breaks



✅ Sick Time: 40 hours per year



✅ Paid Time Off: 40 hours during the first year



✅ PTO Growth: Increases to 80 hours after two years of employment



✅ Performance Reviews: Opportunities for compensation increases based on performance and growth within the position



✅ Long-Term Growth: Opportunity to take on additional administrative, scheduling, compliance, and operational responsibilities as Free Life Wellness Center continues to grow



♦️ HOW TO APPLY



We want to keep the application process simple!



♦️ STEP 1: RECORD A SHORT VIDEO – 2–3 MINUTES



Upload your video to Loom, YouTube (unlisted), or another shareable video platform.



In your video, please tell us:



✅ Who you are and where you're from.



✅ Why you're interested in this position with Free Life Wellness Center.



✅ Tell us about your previous work experience, including any experience with data entry, scheduling, healthcare or behavioral health, compliance, HIPAA/confidential information, Google Workspace, or electronic health record systems.



✅ Why you think you would be a good fit for this position.



Your video does not need to be highly produced. Keep it professional, conversational, and be yourself! We want to learn more about you, your experience, and how you communicate.



♦️ STEP 2: SUBMIT YOUR APPLICATION



Please include:



✅ Your résumé in PDF format.



✅ A link to your 2–3 minute introduction video.



SUBJECT LINE: Administrative Data & Compliance Assistant – [Your Name]



♦️ WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR IN YOUR APPLICATION



We're looking for someone who:



✅ Follows application instructions.



✅ Communicates clearly and professionally.



✅ Pays close attention to detail.



✅ Has relevant administrative, healthcare, scheduling, compliance, or data-entry experience.



✅ Understands the importance of HIPAA, privacy, and confidentiality.



✅ Is reliable, organized, and eager to learn.



✅ Is genuinely interested in a stable, long-term position with Free Life Wellness Center.



Candidates selected to move forward will be invited to a video interview with our team.



We look forward to learning more about you!

title: Senior Loan Processor
description:
About DreamPoint Capital

DreamPoint Capital is a private real estate lending brokerage specializing in DSCR (debt service coverage ratio) loans, residential transition loans (RTL/fix-and-flip), bridge financing, and commercial loan placements for real estate investors across the United States. We work with a deep network of institutional and private capital lenders to match borrowers with the right loan program and close transactions quickly.

We're a lean, technology-forward team. Our reps use proprietary AI-powered scenario matching, an AI receptionist, and modern loan workflow tooling — we expect our processors to be comfortable in that environment and contribute to making it better.



The Role

We're hiring an experienced loan processor to own files from submission through funding. You'll be the operational backbone between our reps, borrowers, and lenders — collecting conditions, structuring deals correctly the first time, and pushing files to close on tight investor timelines.

This is not an entry-level role. We need someone who can read a tri-merge, spot a DSCR shortfall, anticipate what a lender will ask for before they ask, and run multiple files in parallel without dropping balls.

What you'll do



Manage a pipeline of 15–25+ active DSCR, RTL, and bridge loan files concurrently from intake through funding

Review borrower intake packages for completeness — entity docs, credit, liquidity, experience, schedule of real estate owned, lease agreements, rent rolls, purchase contracts, rehab budgets, insurance binders

Order and review third-party reports: appraisals, BPOs, title commitments, flood certs, payoff statements, HOA estoppels

Calculate and verify DSCR, LTV, LTC, ARV, and debt yield against each lender's specific guideline matrix

Coordinate with title companies, attorneys, insurance agents, and lender underwriters to clear conditions

Prep clean submission packages and respond to lender conditions with precision and speed

Track every file in our loan management system; keep status notes current so reps and borrowers always know where things stand

Review closing disclosures and settlement statements for accuracy before close

Flag deal-killers early — title issues, appraisal gaps, entity structure problems, seasoning issues, recognition agreement requirements on co-op collateral

Contribute to process improvement — if a workflow is broken, you tell us and help fix it



What you need



5+ years of loan processing experience, with at least 2 years in non-QM, DSCR, fix-and-flip, bridge, or commercial real estate lending (this is non-negotiable — conventional/agency-only experience is not a fit)

Working knowledge of US private lending guidelines from at least a few of: Kiavi, Lima One, RCN, Roc Capital, Velocity, Visio, Constructive, LendingOne, Builders Capital, or similar

Comfort with entity-titled loans (LLC, LP, corporation), personal guarantees, and the documentation that comes with them

Sharp Excel skills — you can build a quick DSCR calc, reconcile a settlement statement, and audit a rent roll without complaint

Excellent written English — you will be in direct
 and Slack contact with US-based lenders, attorneys, and borrowers

Strong reading comprehension for legal and financial documents — title commitments, operating agreements, leases, purchase contracts

Self-directed work style; you don't need someone standing over you to hit deadlines

Reliable home office: stable high-speed internet, quiet environment, backup power, modern computer

Available for at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern time daily



Nice to have



Experience with co-op collateral, ground leases, or other complex collateral structures

Familiarity with TRID, RESPA, and basic compliance frameworks (even though most of our products are business-purpose and exempt)

Prior experience at a US-based lender, broker, or BPO supporting US lending operations

Comfort with modern tools: Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, AI tools (ChatGPT/Claude), and willingness to learn our internal apps

Exposure to title work, escrow coordination, or insurance review



What we offer



Competitive USD-denominated salary commensurate with experience (target range disclosed in first interview)

Performance bonuses tied to closed loan volume and file cycle time

Paid time off and Philippine holidays observed

Equipment stipend

Direct access to founder and senior team — your work has visible impact on the business

Growth path into senior operations, team lead, or underwriting roles as we scale



How to apply

Send a resume and a brief cover note describing the most complex loan file you've ever processed — what made it hard, and how you got it closed — to 
]. Please include "Senior Loan Processor — [Your Name]" in the subject line.

Candidates who pass initial screen will complete a paid case study using a real (anonymized) DSCR scenario before any final interviews.

They paste the link of any online store whose look they love, and our AI builds a ready-to-use Shopify theme in that same style, with a working preview and cart. Store owners get a professional design without hiring a designer. We're hiring a content creator to run all of our organic short-form content, presented by our own AI character.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Create our AI character: the brand's on-screen host, with a consistent face and look, made with AI tools such as Higgsfield.

- Film yourself presenting our videos (talking head, green screen, reactions), then face-swap yourself into the character, so the character's face and voice stay the same in every video.

- Make and post 5 short vertical videos a day for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

- Use the material we provide: before/after visuals of real designs made with our tool, scripts, hooks and voice-overs.

- Edit in CapCut or similar: captions, sound, pacing and trends.

- Schedule everything a week ahead in Metricool, and reply to comments.

- Follow our playbook: brand rules, and the claims we can and can't make.

- Send a short weekly report: what you posted, the best and worst videos, and what you'll try next.



WHAT YOU BRING

- Hands-on experience with AI face swap and AI character creation (Higgsfield or similar).

- Excellent spoken and written English, and a strong on-camera delivery.

- A portfolio of short-form videos you made (links required).

- A strong feel for TikTok hooks, trends and pacing.

- Experience with AI voice tools such as ElevenLabs is a plus.

- Reliable internet.



THE DEAL

- Remote, full-time or part-time.

- Reply with "TEST" and we'll send you a short test. If it's good, we'll continue from there.



TO APPLY

Reply with "TEST", together with links to 3 short-form videos you made, an example of a face swap or AI character you created, and one hook you'd use for a video about "turning any store into your own design".

title: ORM & Community Forum Specialist (SEO) – Part-Time, Remote
description:
Online Reputation Management (ORM) & Community Specialist – SEO / Forums | Part-Time, Remote



TYPE OF WORK: Part Time (20 to 30 hrs/week, agreed with you before starting), can grow to Full Time (40 hrs/week)

WAGE / SALARY: $8.00 to $9.00 per hour, based on experience

HOURS PER WEEK: 20 to 30

LOCATION: Remote



WHY THIS ROLE

- Long-term role with a growing US brand, not a one-off project

- 20 to 30 hours per week, agreed with you before starting, and can grow to 40, with the rate reviewed as the scope grows

- Fixed daily block, Monday to Friday

- Paid on schedule through Wise

- Paid assessment: shortlisted candidates are paid for the 2-hour test, whether or not they move forward



ABOUT US

We are a US-based brand selling car covers and automotive accessories through our own website, Amazon, and eBay.



POSITION OVERVIEW

We're looking for an Online Reputation Management specialist to strengthen our brand's presence in online communities and improve what people see when they search our brand name.



Your main focus: monitor and join relevant forums, spot reputation risks early, and help legitimate positive or neutral content rank above negative results over time.



This is not a customer-service or review-reply role.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Community Forums

- Find forums and communities where people discuss our brand, products, competitors, or industry

- Monitor brand mentions, complaints, misinformation, and product questions

- Join discussions with helpful, natural, non-promotional replies

- Flag forum threads that rank for our brand name and recommend how to handle them

- Escalate legal threats, safety complaints, refund disputes, or coordinated attacks



Branded Search & Suppression

- Track page-one and page-two Google results for priority brand searches

- Identify negative URLs and how likely they are to be outranked

- Build and optimize legitimate brand assets (profiles, listings, articles, videos, interviews)

- Coordinate branded content that can take more first-page positions

- D
 whether a result should be corrected, removed, responded to, or outranked



Content & Reporting

- Write briefs for articles, FAQs, company profiles, and customer stories

- Support legitimate third-party placements and interviews

- Keep a simple weekly tracker: negative URL positions, positive assets, new mentions, actions taken, and next steps



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 2+ years in ORM, community management, or branded SEO (1+ year is fine if you have strong, specific examples)

- Hands-on experience in online forums or communities

- Experience tracking branded search results and URL positions

- Good written English and the ability to match each community's tone

- Basic SEO knowledge (search intent, links, authority, indexing)

- Knowing when a public reply would make things worse



NICE TO HAVE

- ORM for an e-commerce or consumer brand

- Digital PR, contributor articles, or editorial mentions

- Google Business Profile, Trustpilot, BBB, Reddit, or industry forums

- Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, or rank-tracking tools



PROHIBITED TACTICS

We only use legitimate, sustainable methods. Not allowed:

- Fake accounts, fake identities, or fake reviews

- Review gating or incentives for positive reviews only

- Mass posting, automated comments, or spam links

- Harassment or coordinated reporting campaigns

- Hiding a company affiliation when a platform requires it

- False claims about competitors

- Promising guaranteed removals or rankings



WORK ARRANGEMENT

- Remote, part-time contractor

- 20 to 30 hrs/week (Mon–Fri), agreed with you before starting. Can grow to 40 based on performance and workload

- Your daily hours fall within 7:00 AM–3:30 PM US Pacific Time (10:00 PM–6:30 AM PH Time). The exact block is set with your manager

- Weekly progress report

- During training, public replies and new community activity are approved before posting



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph or
 
 NOT apply to 



1. Put COVERLAND at the start of your application (subject line or first line)

2. Attach your resume

3. Answer the 3 questions below. A few sentences each is enough. Specific examples matter more than length.



Q1. Your ORM experience

Describe one brand you personally handled ORM for: industry, when (month/year), your role, and whether you worked alone or in a team. You may anonymize the brand.



Q2. One result you moved

Pick one negative URL: what type of site, its starting and ending Google position (approximate is fine), how long it took, and what you personally did.



Q3. Quick scenario

A negative forum thread ranks #4 for a brand's name. It's several years old, on a strong forum, and still gets occasional comments. What would you do first, what would you avoid, and would you disclose the brand relationship if you posted?



Optional: a redacted sample of a report or ranking tracker you made.



If you haven't done something, just say so. That's completely fine. What counts against you is describing work you didn't personally do.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a paid 2-hour assessment.

title: Marketing & Account Manager
description:
Company: Staff Connect Australia (SCA)

Work Setup: Full-Time | Remote (Work From Home)

Schedule: 40 hours per week

Reporting To: Head of Marketing



About the Role



Staff Connect Australia is looking for an experienced Marketing & Account Manager to support a portfolio of Australian businesses.



We're looking for someone who can do more than just create social media posts. We need a hands-on marketer who can manage day-to-day marketing activities, communicate confidently with clients and stakeholders, and make sure projects and campaigns are delivered on time.



You'll be working closely with business owners, management teams and our internal marketing team to plan, coordinate and execute marketing activities across multiple brands.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both the creative side of marketing and the responsibility of managing client relationships.



What You'll Be Doing



- Marketing & Account Management

- Act as the main point of contact for marketing-related requests and updates.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and stakeholders.

- Attend regular meetings to discuss priorities, campaigns and ongoing projects.

- Manage marketing calendars, deadlines and deliverables.

- Coordinate feedback, approvals and requests with the internal marketing team.

- Provide regular updates on completed tasks, ongoing projects and upcoming priorities.



Social Media & Content Creation



- Plan, create and schedule content for
 and Instagram.

- Manage content calendars across multiple brands.

- Create social media graphics and marketing materials using Canva.

- Edit short-form videos and Reels.

- Write engaging captions, promotional content and marketing copy.

- Monitor social media engagement and identify opportunities for improvement.



 Marketing



- Create, schedule and manage
 marketing campaigns (EDMs).

- Write
 copy and prepare promotional newsletters.

- Maintain
 lists and assist with audience segmentation.

- Review campaign performance and suggest improvements.



Website & SEO



- Update website content, blogs and promotional pages.

- Write and edit website copy.

- Apply basic SEO practices to improve content visibility.

- Coordinate website updates with the appropriate team members.



Brand Management & Reporting



- Maintain consistent branding across all marketing channels.

- Coordinate creative materials, photos, videos and other marketing assets.

- Monitor campaign performance and prepare marketing reports.

- Track marketing activities, deadlines and project progress.

- Identify opportunities to improve marketing processes and results.



What We're Looking For



- At least 3 years of experience in digital marketing, marketing management or account management.

- Experience managing multiple brands, clients or marketing accounts.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong communication and relationship management skills.

- Experience managing
 and Instagram business accounts.

- Proficiency in Canva and basic video editing.

- Experience creating and managing
 marketing campaigns.

- Familiarity with website content management and basic SEO.

- Strong organisational and time management skills.

- Ability to work independently, manage priorities and meet deadlines.

- A proactive attitude and strong attention to detail.



Experience With These Tools Is an Advantage



- Canva

- Meta Business Suite

- Mailchimp or similar
 marketing platforms

- WordPress or similar website platforms

- Google Analytics (GA4)

- Google Business Profile

- HubSpot

- CapCut or Adobe Creative Cloud

- Google Ads and Meta Ads



You don't need to be an expert in every tool, but you should be comfortable learning new systems and working across different marketing platforms.



Bonus Points If You Have



- Experience working with Australian clients or businesses.

- Previous experience in a marketing agency or client-facing role.

- Experience in hospitality, tourism, accommodation, property or lifestyle marketing.

- Experience coordinating marketing campaigns across multiple brands.

- A portfolio showing social media content,
 campaigns or other marketing projects you've worked on.



What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?



We're looking for someone who:



- Takes ownership of their work and follows through on commitments.

- Communicates clearly and professionally with clients and team members.

- Can manage multiple projects without constant supervision.

- Is comfortable both planning campaigns and doing the actual marketing work.

- Pays attention to detail and knows when to ask questions.

- Brings ideas to the table rather than simply waiting for instructions.

- Enjoys working with a team and building strong professional relationships.



Why Join Staff Connect Australia?



You'll have the opportunity to work with established Australian businesses, gain experience across different industries and take ownership of meaningful marketing projects.



You'll also be supported by SCA's wider marketing team, including experienced marketing and creative professionals.



We value people who are reliable, proactive, willing to learn and genuinely care about the quality of their work.



How to Apply



If you think you'd be a great fit, we'd love to hear from you!



Please send us:



- Your updated CV or resume.

- A link to your portfolio or samples of previous marketing work.

- A short introduction explaining your experience managing marketing activities and client relationships.

- Details of the marketing tools and platforms you've worked with.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist
description:
Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Growth Pathway to Sales Manager / Team Leader



Company: Staff Connect (on behalf of our client)

Location: Remote – Philippines-based

Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)

Compensation: Competitive base salary + performance incentives + sales bonuses, with high performers able to earn up to PHP 100,000 per month through bonus opportunities.

Schedule: Rotating 10-hour shifts across AEST business hours, with approximately 3–4 shifts rostered per week.

Leave: One week paid leave per year



About the Client



Our client is Australia’s leading misfuelling specialist, providing nationwide roadside assistance to motorists who a
 put the wrong fuel in their vehicle.



Their team supports customers during stressful situations by delivering fast, professional, and empathetic service while coordinating technicians across Australia.



Staff Connect is partnering with the client to build and expand their offshore operations team in the Philippines, creating strong long-term career opportunities for high-performing individuals with leadership potential.



The Opportunity

Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Career Progression to Sales Manager / Team Leader



This is a fast-paced, sales-driven role focused on converting inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings while delivering exceptional customer support.



You will manage inbound roadside assistance calls, coordinate technicians nationwide, and ensure urgent jobs are handled efficiently from start to finish.



This role is best suited to candidates with previous roadside assistance, emergency dispatch, towing, transport coordination, or high-volume dispatching experience, as the environment requires strong multitasking skills, urgency, and confidence managing time-sensitive situations.



High-performing team members who consistently achieve strong sales results and operational excellence will have the opportunity to progress into leadership roles and eventually help manage the offshore team.



Performance Expectations



Successful candidates will be expected to:



- Achieve a minimum of 35 confirmed jobs sold per month

- Maintain strong inbound conversion rates

- Deliver exceptional customer service under pressure

- Efficiently coordinate and manage live dispatch operations

- Accurately handle bookings, job updates, and technician coordination

- Maximise every inbound sales opportunity



This role is ideal for individuals who are confident in sales, highly organised, calm under pressure, and experienced in fast-moving dispatch environments.



Key Responsibilities

Inbound Sales & Customer Service

- Handle inbound calls from customers requiring urgent roadside assistance

- Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through confident communication and objection handling

- Deliver calm, empathetic, and professional customer support

- Collect deposits and accurately record booking information

- Meet and exceed monthly sales targets and KPIs



Dispatch & Operations Coordination

- Coordinate technicians across Australia using dispatch and booking platforms

- Monitor live jobs and technician availability in real time

- Manage cases from initial enquiry through to completion

- Communicate with customers and technicians via phone, Slack, Gmail, and SMS

- Prioritise urgent and high-pressure jobs efficiently



Quality Control & Administration

- Review jobs daily to ensure accurate completion and closure

- Identify missed opportunities, incomplete bookings, or operational issues

- Maintain accurate records in GeoOp and Xero

- Ensure ETAs, notes, discounts, and call outcomes are properly logged

- Support operational compliance and workflow accuracy



Process Improvement & Team Support

- Assist with updating templates, documents, and operational processes

- Participate in Slack huddles, training sessions, and coaching

- Support escalated customer concerns when required

- Contribute ideas to improve dispatch efficiency and customer experience

- Be comfortable participating in video meetings and team collaboration



What We’re Looking For

Essential Requirements

- Minimum 2 years’ experience in:

- Roadside assistance dispatch

- Emergency or high-volume dispatch environments

- Strong understanding of fast-paced roadside assistance workflows and urgent customer situations

- Experience coordinating mobile technicians and managing live jobs in real time

- Ability to confidently explain services and convert inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings

- Strong communication and objection-handling skills

- Excellent attention to detail when managing bookings, ETAs, and customer updates

- Calm, professional, and solutions-focused under pressure

- Comfortable supporting customers dealing with vehicle misfuelling i
, including fuel extraction, fuel replacement, and vehicle testing services

- Proficient in Google Workspace, Gmail, and web-based dispatch systems

- Comfortable using Slack and participating in online meetings and huddles

- Reliable work-from-home setup with stable internet connection



Highly Regarded

- Previous experience in:

- Misfuelling or fuel recovery services

- Automotive roadside assistance

- Mechanical or vehicle service coordination

- Knowledge of Australian roads and geography

- Experience working with Australian customers or operations

- Leadership, coaching, or team mentoring experience



What’s in It for You

- Fully remote work-from-home opportunity

- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives

- Clear progression pathway into leadership roles

- Ongoing training and development

- Opportunity to work with a growing international team

- Supportive and collaborative work culture

- Long-term career growth opportunities for high performers

title: Paid Media Specialist — Google & Meta Ads | Australian Agency
description:
Paid Media Specialist — Google & Meta Ads | Australian Agency



Remote, Philippines | 20 hours per week | US$12–15/hour depending on experience



Help Australian businesses generate better leads—and keep their campaigns running smoothly.



Margin Media is an award-winning Australian growth agency managing Google, Meta and LinkedIn advertising for service-based and B2B clients. We care about the enquiries, customers and revenue our campaigns help generate.



We’re looking for an experienced Paid Media Specialist to become a dependable part of our team. You’ll manage smaller-budget accounts, handle routine account maintenance, run Meta campaigns and prepare monthly reports that explain what happened and what to do next.



This is an ongoing, hands-on role for someone who takes pride in the details, communicates clearly and knows when to act independently or raise an issue.



You’ll start with approximately 4–5 client accounts, with responsibilities matched to your experience and available hours. You’ll also provide broader account cover while our Australian team takes its Christmas and New Year break.



**What you’ll do**



- **Keep accounts healthy:** check spend and budget pacing, investigate delivery issues, review disapproved ads, and check landing pages, forms and conversion tracking.

- **Maintain Google Ads campaigns:** review search terms, add negative keywords, refine targeting and identify wasted spend.

- **Run Meta campaigns:** build, launch and optimise lead-generation campaigns; test audiences, copy and creative; monitor lead quality and creative fatigue.

- **Manage smaller-budget accounts:** work within agreed budgets and goals, prioritise useful improvements and document your changes.

- **Prepare monthly reports:** use Looker Studio and platform data to explain performance, lead quality, key changes and recommended next steps.

- **Keep the team informed:** flag problems early, maintain clear account notes and follow through on agreed actions.



**Christmas and New Year cover**



An important part of this role is taking day-to-day responsibility for the agency’s active advertising accounts during our team’s holiday break.



You’ll monitor performance and spend, maintain agreed campaign plans, resolve routine issues and escalate urgent problems through an agreed contact.



We’ll provide account handovers and agree the coverage dates, account allocation, working hours and decision-making limits before the break. Additional hours will be agreed and paid. Any weekend or public-holiday coverage will also be discussed in advance.



Please include your December and January availability, along with any planned leave, in your application.



**What you’ll bring**



- Ideally 3+ years of hands-on Google Ads and Meta Ads experience, including managing multiple client accounts.

- Proven lead-generation experience for service businesses or B2B clients.

- Confidence managing smaller budgets and identifying practical ways to reduce wasted spend.

- Working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager and Meta conversion tracking, including how to investigate tracking problems.

- Experience preparing Looker Studio reports with clear written insights.

- An understanding of lead quality and how CRM outcomes can inform campaign decisions.

- Strong written and spoken English, attention to detail and reliable follow-through.

- Reliable internet and a practical backup plan for connectivity or power interruptions.



Experience with HubSpot, GoHighLevel and LinkedIn Ads would be valuable. Please explain which platforms you can manage independently.



**Working with us**



- Ongoing remote work, starting at 20 hours per week.

- US$12–15 per hour, depending on demonstrated experience.

- Agreed working hours with overlap during Brisbane business hours.

- Collaboration with an Australian agency team, with clear account priorities and handovers.

- Scope to take on more responsibility as we establish a strong working relationship.



**How to apply**



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with:



1. A brief summary of your experience, including the number of accounts and typical monthly budgets you’ve personally managed.

2. One example of a lead-generation campaign you improved: what was happening, what you changed and how you measured the result. Include lead quality where available.

3. An anonymised monthly report or a short example of your reporting commentary.

4. Your preferred hourly rate, earliest start date, weekly availability and any planned December or January leave.



Please remove client names and confidential information from examples.



Our hiring process is an introductory call, a short paid practical task and a final interview.



We’re looking for someone who combines sound campaign judgement with consistent, careful execution. If that sounds like you, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Property Manager (New York City experience)
description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly organized Property Manager to oversee the full-cycle management of a residential rental portfolio in New York City. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing residential rental properties, working with Section 8 (Housing Choice Voucher) programs, and ensuring compliance with New York City and New York State housing regulations.



This role requires a hands-on professional capable of managing all aspects of residential property operations, from tenant acquisition and lease execution to rent collection, maintenance coordination, regulatory compliance, tenant relations, and lease renewals.



The successful candidate must have a strong understanding of NYC rental laws, affordable housing requirements, Section 8 procedures, and the operational demands of managing a residential rental portfolio.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Full-Cycle Property Management

- Oversee the day-to-day operations and full lifecycle management of residential rental properties.

- Manage the leasing process, including property marketing, tenant inquiries, applicant screening, and lease execution.

- Coordinate tenant move-ins, move-outs, inspections, and security deposit administration.

- Manage lease renewals, rent increases, notices, and lease terminations in accordance with applicable laws.

- Maintain accurate property records, tenant files, lease agreements, and operational documentation.

- Monitor occupancy rates, vacancies, rental performance, and property operating expenses.



2. Section 8 & Affordable Housing Management

- Manage properties participating in the Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher Program.

- Coordinate with NYC Housing Authority (NYCHA) and other applicable housing agencies.

- Process Section 8 applications, voucher documentation, rent reasonableness reviews, and Housing Assistance Payment (HAP) contracts.

- Coordinate initial, annual, and follow-up housing inspections.

- Ensure timely submission of required documentation and correction of inspection deficiencies.

- Monitor subsidy payments, tenant portions of rent, recertifications, and changes in household eligibility.

- Maintain compliance with applicable HUD and local affordable housing program requirements.



3. NYC Real Estate Rental Compliance

- Ensure compliance with New York City and New York State residential rental laws and regulations.

- Maintain working knowledge of NYC rent stabilization requirements, where applicable.

- Oversee compliance with applicable HPD, DOB, DHCR, and other regulatory requirements.

- Monitor property registration, required notices, inspections, and housing-related filings.

- Ensure compliance with NYC Housing Maintenance Code, applicable building and safety requirements, and lead-based paint regulations.

- Understand Fair Housing laws, source-of-income discrimination protections, and applicable tenant protections.

- Coordinate responses to regulatory violations, tenant complaints, and agency inquiries.

- Maintain accurate and audit-ready compliance documentation.



4. Rent Collection & Financial Management

- Oversee monthly rent collection, delinquency monitoring, and accounts receivable.

- Track tenant balances, Section 8 subsidy payments, and outstanding receivables.

- Coordinate payment follow-ups and legally compliant rent collection procedures.

- Assist with annual operating budgets, expense tracking, and financial reporting.

- Review property expenses, vendor invoices, and maintenance costs.

- Provide regular reports on rental income, occupancy, arrears, and property performance.



5. Maintenance & Vendor Management

- Coordinate routine, preventive, and emergency maintenance.

- Supervise contractors, vendors, and maintenance personnel.

- Obtain and review vendor estimates and oversee maintenance work.

- Ensure timely resolution of tenant maintenance requests.

- Monitor property conditions and ensure compliance with health and safety standards.

- Coordinate repairs required to satisfy HPD, DOB, and Section 8 inspection requirements.



6. Tenant Relations & Dispute Resolution

- Serve as the primary point of contact for tenants and prospective residents.

- Handle tenant concerns, complaints, lease issues, and maintenance escalations.

- Maintain professional communication with tenants, housing agencies, vendors, and property owners.

- Address lease violations and tenant disputes in accordance with applicable legal procedures.

- Support tenant retention and maintain positive landlord-tenant relationships.



Required Qualifications & Experience



- Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in residential property management, preferably within New York City.

- Demonstrated experience managing residential rental properties and overseeing the full leasing and property management cycle.

- Direct experience with Section 8 / Housing Choice Voucher programs is required.

- Strong working knowledge of NYC rental regulations and landlord-tenant compliance requirements.

- Experience coordinating NYCHA or other housing authority inspections and documentation.

- Understanding of rent stabilization, HPD requirements, DHCR regulations, and applicable NYC housing laws.

- Experience with rent collection, lease administration, tenant screening, renewals, and delinquency management.

- Strong vendor management, maintenance coordination, and budgeting skills.

- Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving abilities.

- Proficiency in property management software, Microsoft Office, and Google Workspace.



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience managing multi-unit residential buildings or a diverse NYC rental portfolio.

- Familiarity with NYC HPD Online, DOB NOW, NYCHA systems, and applicable housing agency portals.

- Experience with affordable housing, subsidized housing, and government-assisted rental programs.

- Knowledge of eviction prevention processes and NYC Housing Court procedures.

- Experience preparing property performance reports and compliance documentation.

- Real estate or property management certification is an advantage.



How to Apply



Interested candidates should submit their resume outlining their experience in NYC residential property management, Section 8 administration, and New York City rental compliance to 
 must have practical, hands-on experience managing NYC residential rental properties and navigating Section 8 housing requirements. General property management experience without direct NYC rental compliance and Section 8 experience will not be sufficient.
