title: JR. FINANCIAL ANALYST – COST & MARGIN ANALYSIS
description:
ABOUT STARBOND



Starbond is a U.S.-based adhesive company serving customers through e-commerce and B2B channels. We’re looking for a detail-oriented Jr. Financial Analyst to help us understand product costs, monitor profitability, and support financial decisions.



ABOUT THE ROLE



Your primary focus will be maintaining accurate SKU-level cost models and analyzing contribution margins across products and sales channels. You will work closely with Supply Chain, Operations, Sales, and Finance to validate inputs, investigate variances, and explain changes in costs and profitability.



This is a hands-on role requiring strong Excel skills, accuracy, and the ability to turn financial data into clear, practical insights.



PRIMARY FOCUS: COST, MARGIN & PROFITABILITY ANALYSIS (80%)



Own and maintain SKU-level cost models covering materials, labor, packaging, freight, and overhead.



Validate cost inputs and update assumptions when suppliers, freight rates, labor costs, or production processes change.



Maintain contribution margin analysis by SKU and sales channel.



Analyze how supplier changes, freight fluctuations, and production updates affect margins.



Evaluate the margin impact of promotions, discounts, and pricing changes.



Investigate unusual cost or margin variances, explain the key drivers, and flag concerns.



ADDITIONAL SUPPORT AREAS (20%)



Experience in the following areas is an advantage.



Financial Reporting & Variance Analysis



Maintain monthly P&L and margin reports using standardized templates.



Compare actual results against budgets, forecasts, and prior-month performance.



Identify financial trends and explain key variances.



Maintain Excel dashboards, pivot tables, and financial models, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and proper version control.



Cash Flow, Inventory & Working Capital



Update weekly cash flow forecast inputs and cash balance trackers.



Track inventory value and inventory turns using predefined formulas.



Model the cash impact of inventory purchases, production timing, and supplier payment terms.



Maintain B2B accounts receivable aging reports.



Cross-Functional Coordination



Collect and validate material, freight, and supplier cost inputs with Supply Chain.



Confirm labor rates, overhead, and production assumptions with Operations.



Collect sales volume and channel inputs from Sales.



Keep financial inputs and models aligned across departments.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.



At least 5 years of experience in financial analysis, cost accounting, or operational finance.



Strong Excel proficiency, including pivot tables, lookup formulas, and structured financial models.



Hands-on experience working with cost models, margin analysis, or inventory data.



Strong attention to detail and the ability to organize and validate multiple data inputs.



Ability to investigate discrepancies and clearly explain findings.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



Experience in manufacturing, e-commerce, or a supply chain–driven business.



Exposure to inventory accounting, landed cost modeling, or contribution margin analysis.



Experience supporting pricing decisions or promotional analysis.



Familiarity with ERP or accounting systems.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit your updated resume and briefly answer the following questions:



Describe a cost or margin model you personally built or maintained. What inputs did it include, and how was it used?



Share an example of a cost or margin discrepancy you identified and how you investigated it.



Which Excel tools and formulas do you regularly use for financial analysis?

title: Network Specialist
description:
Company: IT Connect Holdings

Location: Remote (Philippines / Kuala Lumpur - UTC+8)

Employment Type: Full-Time

About IT Connect

IT Connect is a premier provider of enterprise-class IT design, consulting, and assessment services. We specialise in providing effective IT managed solutions that reduce the total cost of ownership of client network environments while enhancing systems reliability and productivity.

Position Overview

We are seeking a full-time Remote Network Specialist based in the Philippines/Kuala Lumpur time zone to join our team. In this role, you will take ownership of network changes, client infrastructure maintenance, and escalated support. You will design, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain network environments across multi-tenant client sites using both GUI and CLI interfaces-ensuring solutions are secure, reliable, documented, and aligned with company standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Network Infrastructure & Security Management: Deploy, configure, and maintain business-class firewalls (Fortinet FortiGate, SonicWall, and Cisco), switches (Cisco, HP/Aruba), and wireless access points (APs).

• Firewall Policies & Access Controls: Create, audit, and optimize least-privilege firewall policies, NAT rules, network segmentation, site-to-site VPNs, and remote-access VPNs.

• Backup & Restoration Management: Establish, execute, and verify routine network configuration backup and restoration procedures to ensure rapid disaster recovery and business continuity.

• Escalation Support & Service Desk Collaboration: Act as an escalation point for Network Technicians and service desk staff. Resolve escalated tickets, perform root-cause diagnostics, and mentor junior technicians on networking concepts, troubleshooting methods, and documentation standards.

• Network Troubleshooting: Lead structured, evidence-based troubleshooting across Layers 1 through 7 (connectivity, routing, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, VPN, firewall, wireless, and performance) using packet captures, device logs, and network monitoring tools.

• Change Management & Planning: Develop implementation, testing, validation, and rollback plans prior to production network changes, leading scheduled maintenance windows to minimize client disruption.

• Documentation & Standards: Maintain accurate network standards, configuration templates, network topology diagrams, and as-built documentation following installations or major changes.

• Assessments & Migrations: Assist with network site assessments, infrastructure refreshes, hardware migrations, and new client onboardings.

Technical Knowledge & Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

• Certifications: CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate) or CCNP required; equivalent firewall certifications (e.g., Fortinet NSE 4+) are highly regarded.

• Vendor Experience: Hands-on experience configuring and managing:

o Firewalls: Cisco, Fortinet (FortiGate), and SonicWall.

o Switching & Wireless: Cisco and HP/Aruba switches, routers, and wireless access points.

• Interface Competency: Proven ability to manage network hardware fluently using both GUI and Command Line Interface (CLI) environments.

• Core Technical Knowledge:

o Practical knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4, subnetting, Ethernet, VLANs, trunking, Layer 2 switching, STP, static/dynamic routing, DHCP, and DNS.

o Deep understanding of NAT, firewall policies, network segmentation, VPNs (IPsec/SSL), and high availability/redundancy.

o Experience with packet capture tools (e.g., Wireshark), protocol analysis, log analysis, and network monitoring tools.

• Execution & Reliability: Demonstrated ability to independently deploy small client networks or major network components, plan production changes with rollback procedures, and execute backup/restoration procedures.

• Communication & Documentation: Excellent technical documentation skills and the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to technicians, management, and clients.

Nice-to-Have / Preferred Qualifications:

• MSP Experience: Prior experience working for a Managed Service Provider (MSP) managing multi-tenant client environments.

• Service Desk & PSA Tools: Familiarity with standard ticketing/PSA systems (e.g., HaloPSA, ConnectWise, Autotask, ServiceNow).

• Customer Service Orientation: Strong customer-first mindset with clear written and verbal English communication skills.

• Network Automation: Basic scripting or configuration management skills (e.g., Python, Ansible) to automate repetitive backup, configuration, or monitoring tasks.

Location & Working Hours

• Schedule: Full-Time – Monday to Friday (Some weekend work may be required for scheduled maintenance).

• Location: 100% Remote (Candidate based in the Philippines or Kuala Lumpur / UTC+8 time zone).

• Wages are in Canadian Dollars

• Shift Hours:

o Pacific Time (PT): 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM (Monday – Friday)

o Local Philippines / KL Time: 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM (Tuesday – Saturday morning)

o Overlap: 2-hour daily overlap with the Vancouver team from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM PT (6:00 AM to 8:00 AM local time).

o Note: Our Vancouver office observes daylight time year-round, so these working hours remain fixed throughout the year.

• Remote Setup Requirements: Dedicated home office space with reliable high-speed internet and backup power/internet connectivity.

Daily

Ongoing



Enter vendor bills and record payments against them

Post credit card activity

Post payroll and benefits entries each pay cycle

Reconcile all bank and credit card accounts

Close the month by business day 10



Year-end



Support year-end close  as required.

• Reliable high-speed internet, backup power or internet, a quality headset, and a quiet place to work.

• Available full-time during US Eastern business hours.

• Experience calling real estate agents (ISA, real estate VA or appointment setter).

• Experience with GoHighLevel, a power dialer or another CRM.

• Experience selling a service to small businesses.



TOOLS YOU'LL USE

GoHighLevel, Quo (OpenPhone), Zillow, Slack, and Google Workspace. We'll train you on our services, pricing and call scripts.



HOW TO APPLY

A recorded video response is required for every application. Applications submitted without a video will not be reviewed.



Apply here: 



The application takes about 10 minutes plus a short video (3 to 6 minutes, in English) where you answer 5 questions, including a short role play of a cold call. Please also upload your resume.

• Starts with a 2-week paid trial.

Bluegrass Real Estate Media welcomes applicants of every background and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, or any other protected status.

title: Printer Technical Support Specialist
description:
About the Role

Barrister Global Services Network, Inc. is hiring a remote Printer Technical Support Specialist to guide our field Customer Engineers (CEs) through printer and copier repairs in real time. When a CE is on-site in front of a machine and cannot clear a fault, you are the expert they call.



This is not a general IT, helpdesk, or desktop/laptop support role. It is built for people with hands-on printer hardware repair experience.



• Location: Remote, open worldwide

• Employment type: Full-time

• Reports to: Technical Support Manager



Key Responsibilities

• Use OEM service manuals to look up error codes, isolate failed components, and confirm the correct replacement parts.

• Walk CEs step by step through component-level work on fusers, drums, toner and imaging units, rollers, sensors, and feed assemblies.

• Act as the escalation point for complex or unresolved technical issues.

• Coordinate with manufacturers and vendors on advanced troubleshooting and case management.

• Monitor active service tickets so they are updated on time and properly documented.

• Keep repair reports, asset records, and case notes accurate.



Required Qualifications

• 2+ years of hands-on experience repairing printers, copiers, or multifunction devices, as a field technician, bench technician, or OEM technical support agent.

• Strong knowledge of printer hardware components and how they work together: fuser, drum, toner, transfer belt, rollers, sensors, and boards.

• Proven experience diagnosing hardware faults and replacing parts, not only software or driver issues.

• Able to read and apply OEM service manuals, error code tables, and parts catalogs.

• Hands-on experience with at least two major printer or copier brands.

• Experience supporting or working alongside field technicians or Customer Engineers.

• Familiar with ticketing systems and remote support tools.

• Clear, confident English, with the ability to guide someone through a repair under time pressure.

• Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a quiet workspace.



Preferred Qualifications

• Manufacturer certifications (HP, Lexmark, Xerox, Konica Minolta, Kyocera, or similar).

• Experience with Canon, Ricoh, Sharp, or Brother devices.

• Experience handling warranty claims or vendor escalations.



Please Note

Applicants whose experience is limited to general IT support, desktop or laptop support, or service desk work will not be considered. In your application, describe your printer and copier repair experience specifically: brands, models, and the repairs you performed.

title: Senior Demand & Supply Planner
description:
Who We Are

Starbond is a growing adhesive company committed to excellence, customer centricity, curiosity, humility, and continuous improvement. We sell through Amazon, Shopify, and B2B channels and are strengthening our supply chain planning capabilities to support reliable product availability and scalable growth.



The Role

Starbond is seeking a highly analytical and proactive Senior Demand & Supply Planner to own our end-to-end planning process—from developing a reliable demand forecast to translating it into executable purchasing, materials, production, and distribution plans.



This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical expertise, independent judgment, cross-functional leadership, and ownership. You will challenge assumptions, quantify risks, recommend priorities, and improve planning processes with minimal supervision.



This position requires substantial hands-on experience in BOTH demand planning and supply planning, including BOM explosion and material requirements planning (MRP). If your experience is limited to production planning or scheduling, procurement, or inventory monitoring without ownership of demand forecasts and the resulting supply plans, please do not apply.



We use Cin7, supported by Excel for planning, analysis, validation, and scenario modeling. You must understand the calculations behind system recommendations and be able to independently build, audit, and improve Excel-based planning and MRP models.



Candidates who rely heavily on system-generated outputs and cannot independently perform, explain, and validate planning calculations in Excel will not meet the requirements.



Key Responsibilities

Demand Planning and Forecast Ownership

Own the rolling SKU- and channel-level demand forecast across Amazon, Shopify, and B2B.

Develop forecasts using sales history, seasonality, promotions, customer commitments, product life cycles, channel plans, and future business assumptions.

Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and leadership to gather inputs, challenge assumptions, resolve differences, and establish a documented consensus demand plan.

Separate baseline demand from promotional, event-driven, new-product, and one-time demand.

Track forecast accuracy and bias by SKU and channel, investigate significant variances, and improve forecasting methods.

Maintain documented assumptions, risks, opportunities, scenarios, and forecast version history.

Identify demand changes early and communicate their impact on inventory, purchasing, production, capacity, and cash flow.



Supply and Inventory Planning

Translate the demand forecast into time-phased inventory, purchasing, production, and distribution requirements.

Develop constrained and unconstrained supply plans, identifying supplier, material, capacity, cash, and storage limitations.

Establish and maintain SKU-level reorder points, safety stock, order quantities, and inventory targets.

Apply appropriate safety-stock methods using service-level targets, demand variability, lead-time variability, and supplier reliability.

Monitor stockout risks, excess inventory, slow-moving products, inventory turnover, and service levels.

Recommend prioritized actions that balance product availability, working capital, operating cost, and business risk.

Monitor execution and revise plans as demand, supply, and operating conditions change.



BOM Explosion, Materials, and Production Planning

Perform BOM explosion to translate finished-goods requirements into raw-material, component, and packaging requirements.

Calculate time-phased net material requirements, accounting for available inventory, open orders, lead times, minimum order quantities, yields, and scrap.

Determine what needs to be purchased or produced, in what quantities, and when.

Validate BOM accuracy and identify missing, outdated, or inconsistent planning inputs.

Translate demand and material availability into feasible production plans and schedules.

Identify material shortages, capacity conflicts, and timing risks early and recommend practical solutions.

Coordinate with Procurement, Operations, suppliers, and warehouse partners to align purchasing, materials, and production plans.



Cin7, Excel, and Planning Tool Development

Own and improve planning workflows using Cin7 and supporting Excel-based tools.

Maintain and validate planning inputs, including SKU records, forecasts, BOMs, inventory balances, open purchase orders, supplier lead times, and production requirements.

Independently build, audit, and improve Excel-based forecasting, replenishment, and MRP models, including building models from the ground up when needed.

Connect demand forecasts, BOMs, inventory, open orders, lead times, and production requirements into reliable planning calculations.

Validate system-generated recommendations against underlying data and planning logic.

Build formulas, data-validation controls, exception flags, dashboards, and scenario models that are accurate and easy to maintain.

Investigate discrepancies, broken links, duplicated records, manual work, and weak assumptions.

Recommend practical improvements to data quality, system workflows, and automation.

Document planning logic, data sources, ownership, update frequency, and standard operating procedures.



Supply Risk and Scenario Planning

Evaluate supplier performance, including actual versus quoted lead times, delivery reliability, quality issues, and supply variability.

Quantify supply risks and recommend safety-stock adjustments, changes to order timing, or alternative sourcing options.

Develop scenarios for demand changes, supplier delays, promotions, new-product launches, and capacity limitations.

Present alternatives with clear implications for customer service, inventory, cost, and cash flow.

Escalate critical risks promptly with recommended actions, responsible owners, and deadlines.



S&OP and Cross-Functional Leadership

Drive a structured monthly S&OP planning cycle connecting demand, supply, inventory, capacity, and financial considerations.

Lead planning discussions and constructively challenge unsupported assumptions.

Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Operations, and leadership to reconcile demand with supply capabilities and business priorities.

Present concise updates explaining planning gaps, business impact, tradeoffs, and decisions required.

Document agreed decisions and ensure changes flow into forecasts, supply plans, purchasing plans, and production schedules.

Establish clear planning responsibilities and follow through on agreed actions.

Communicate proactively when information is incomplete, assumptions change, or execution is at risk.





Required Qualifications

At least seven years of relevant planning experience, including a minimum of five years of direct, hands-on responsibility spanning both demand planning and supply planning.

Demonstrated ownership of a rolling SKU-level demand forecast and responsibility for translating it into an executable supply plan.

Strong understanding of forecasting methods, seasonality, promotions, forecast accuracy, forecast bias, consensus planning, and scenario analysis.

Practical experience performing BOM explosion, net material requirements calculations, and raw-material or component planning.

Strong knowledge of reorder-point logic, safety-stock modeling, service levels, lead-time variability, and inventory optimization.

Experience translating forecasts into purchasing and production requirements.

Demonstrated ability to build or substantially redesign an Excel-based MRP, inventory-planning, or replenishment model.

Advanced Excel proficiency, including structured tables, XLOOKUP or INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, PivotTables, conditional logic, data validation, error controls, and scenario modeling.

Ability to independently calculate, explain, and validate planning requirements without relying solely on ERP/MRP outputs.

Hands-on experience using an ERP or MRP system for inventory, materials, and production planning. Cin7 experience is strongly preferred.

Proven ability to diagnose planning problems, improve processes, and make sound recommendations with incomplete information.

Ability to influence stakeholders, resolve conflicting priorities, and challenge assumptions respectfully.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong ownership, emotional intelligence, attention to detail, and proactive communication.

Availability to work a full eight-hour shift aligned with Pacific Time business hours.

title: Head of Finance
description:
Reports to: Managing Director. Dotted line to the Chief Executive of the membership business for its priorities

Works with: Finance Lead, Operations. Finance Assistant via the Finance Lead. Operations leads on budgets

Hours: Full time, 40 hours per week

Engagement Independent contractor, Philippines based, remote, Australian business hours overlap

Kindly attach your resume for review.



About the group

A privately owned Australian group of four operating businesses, with a finance team based in the Philippines working to Australian business hours. One of the businesses is a membership organisation funded by supplier rebate income, which is about to take on two new activities: holding and paying supplier accounts on behalf of its members, and offering a paid service tier on top of free membership. The finance function is being strengthened to support that growth.



Purpose

Lead the finance function across the group. Bring the four entities into one clean financial picture with each standing on its own numbers, own budgets and forecasts for all of them, set credit control policy, and be the finance owner of the membership business’s new commercial programs: consolidated supplier accounts, the paid service tier and the rebate P&L. Build the models that say whether things work, the operations that make them run and the controls that stop them going wrong, then hand the running to operations with a documented process while staying accountable for the numbers.



Responsibilities (accountable)

Group consolidation and reporting standards

•Monthly consolidated reporting across the four entities, each on its own numbers; intercompany reconciled, no unexplained balances.

•One set of reporting standards, controls and a month-end calendar for all entities.

•Audit, tax and statutory compliance across entities, including ATO obligations (BAS, IAS, STP, payroll finalisation). Accountant, auditor and bank relationships.

Budgets and forecasting, all entities

•Annual budget and quarterly reforecast for every entity and the group view, built from definitions not rolled forward, including capital equipment replacement allowances.

•The Finance Lead builds the entity detail with operations; this role is accountable for the output.

Australian payroll compliance and Philippines contractor payments

•Accountable for Australian payroll compliance (ATO, STP, superannuation, payroll tax where applicable) and for the Philippines contractor payment framework: agreements on file, agreed hours and rates, any withholding or documentation the contracts require. Approves each payroll run and contractor payment run before it is paid.



Credit control policy

•Credit terms by customer type, credit limits, stop-supply rules, the point at which an account goes to formal recovery.

•One aged debtors report for all entities to the Managing Director every month.

Membership business finance

•Monthly P&L, cash and variance, presented to the Managing Director and Chief Executive and explained.

•Rebate income by supplier, reconciled to supplier statements and member purchasing data. Breakeven and the membership growth needed to reach it.

•Cost and return on member programs so the Chief Executive can see what each costs per member and what it brings in.

Consolidated supplier accounts (design and pilot)

•Design the finance operations before anything is built: invoice intake and matching, member statement cycle, collections and direct debit mandates, supplier payment runs, rebate netting, reconciliations, month-end close.

•Credit limits per member, exposure model (average monthly supplier spend times members on the platform), bad debt watch, suspension path.

•Specify what the platform must produce for finance and test it before go-live. Run the pilot, document, hand to the Finance Lead.

Paid service tier and supplier economics

•Business case and pricing model: fee on managed spend not revenue, a net-ahead test for every member, cash flow timing so the business never funds the gap between collecting and paying. Say plainly if the fee exceeds the benefit for a member type.

•What consolidated prompt payment is worth to a supplier and what additional discount it should buy, additive to the existing rebate.

•The numbers behind every supplier negotiation and renewal; financial pages for the board and partners.

Backup responsibilities (Finance Lead’s areas)

•Able to run month-end close for every entity, collections operations, transaction processing and the live consolidated accounts function. Covers in full during the Finance Lead’s leave.



What this role is not

•Not the commercial designer of the new programs; those decisions sit with the Managing Director and Chief Executive. This role builds and stress tests the numbers and the operations underneath them.

•Not a technology role. It specifies what finance needs from the platform and tests what is delivered.

•Not an advocate for any one entity inside another. Where one group business supplies another, it is treated as any other supplier in every model.



Measures

•Group consolidation delivered monthly; no unexplained intercompany balances within three quarters.

•Membership business reported on its own numbers by the agreed day; rebate P&L closed and maintained.

•Budgets and reforecasts delivered to the calendar for every entity.

•Consolidated accounts process documented, tested and running through pilot, reconciled monthly.

•Paid tier business case and pricing model delivered on real inputs and defensible with the board.

•Debtor days and overdue balances (60 and 90 days) by entity against targets; bad debt written off.

•Owner and backup list in place; leave covered without a gap.



Experience

•Multi-entity finance management, consolidation and intercompany reconciliation. Full set of accounts through to audit, with Australian compliance (ATO, BAS, STP).

•Credit control and collections at scale. Xero essential; NetSuite and MYOB useful. Advanced Excel modelling.

•Leading a finance team across locations; presenting to directors and boards. Membership, rebate or multi-site retail experience useful, not required.

title: Marketing Graphic Designer
description:
Type of work: Full-time, remote, hourly contractor

Location: Philippines

Pay: $8 to $11 USD per hour, based on experience and portfolio

Hours: 40 paid hours per week

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Arizona time, with a 30-minute unpaid lunch break. In the Philippines, that’s 11:00 p.m. to 7:30 a.m. the next morning. The Friday shift ends Saturday morning in the Philippines.

Reviews: At 3, 6, and 12 months, with the possibility of a pay increase based on performance.



About the role



You’ll create on-brand graphics and short videos for Wise Agent’s
s, blog, and social channels. You’ll work from our brand kit, approved templates, and real product screenshots.



Wise Agent is a real estate CRM and website platform used by thousands of agents, teams, and brokers. Our marketing reaches members and prospective members through our weekly
, The Hoot, our monthly newsletter, our blog, social media, and the Becoming a Wise Agent webinar and podcast series.



This role is a great fit if you love precision. You’ll work within our established brand. Success means your work looks unmistakably like Wise Agent, shows the product accurately, and is ready for approval with minimal revisions.

What you’ll do



 graphics: Design hero banners and feature images for The Hoot, the monthly newsletter, and feature announcements. Build clean, image-only graphics using real product screenshots on approved brand gradients.

Social graphics: Create
 and Instagram posts using our templates, including recurring series like Website Wednesday.



Short videos and reels: Turn webinar, podcast, and guest footage into polished clips. Trim for pace, clean up audio where possible, and check captions for accuracy and readability.



Blog banners: Create hero images that reflect the topic and fit our blog’s visual style.

Platform adaptations: Resize and rework layouts for different channels. Check cropping, readability, and placement before exporting.



Product screenshots: Capture clean, high-resolution screenshots from our demo account. Use real Wise Agent screens and keep member and client data out of all assets.



Accuracy and brand checks: Read the related blog post or help article before designing. Verify the logo, colors, fonts, product details, spelling, and dimensions before submitting.



Review and handoff: Share drafts, address all feedback, and route final designs through the marketing manager and Lead Product Designer for approval before publication. Save editable source files and final exports in the shared folders.

Content calendar: Pick up assigned graphics and reels from the monthly calendar, meet deadlines, and communicate early if something is unclear or blocked.



What we’re looking for



At least 2 years of experience creating graphics for marketing,
, or social media.

A portfolio showing a set of designs you created within an existing brand’s guidelines.

Strong visual judgment, including typography, spacing, layout, and readability on mobile.

Short-form video editing skills. You can turn raw or imperfect footage into a clear, engaging reel.

Careful attention to instructions and feedback. You ask questions when something is unclear and check your work before sending it.



Good judgment with AI tools. Use them where they help, but always use our approved logo and real product screenshots. Never generate, redraw, or alter the Wise Agent logo.



Clear written English and reliable communication during the agreed working hours.



Nice to have



Adobe Photoshop or Premiere Pro experience

Motion graphics and animated text for reels

Experience in SaaS, technology, or real estate marketing

Familiarity with
 graphics, image sizing, and export settings



Tools and training



We use Adobe tools, Canva with our brand kit and templates, Claude, Slack, Google Drive, and Wise Agent CRM. We’ll train you on the Wise Agent product, our design standards, and our review process during your first few weeks.



How to apply



Please include:



1. Your résumé and a short note about why this role interests you.



2. A portfolio link with 2 to 3 relevant examples. Include at least one set of graphics you created for an existing brand and one short video you edited. Tell us what you personally did on each example.



3. A brief answer: What do you check before sending a branded graphic or reel for approval?



Your expected hourly rate in USD, earliest available start date, and confirmation that you can consistently work the schedule listed above.



Bonus: Include a short Loom video telling us why you’d be a good fit for Wise Agent. If you can, walk us through one portfolio example and explain how you followed the brand guidelines.



Finalists will be invited to complete a short design exercise using the Wise Agent brand kit. We’ll look at how closely you follow the brief, how accurately you represent the brand and product, and how ready the work is to publish.

title: Operations Lead VA — U.S. Lawn Care Company
description:
We're a growing residential lawn care company in the U.S. (fertilization, weed control, lawn mowing and landscaping), and we're looking for the person who runs the show behind the scenes — a real operations person, not an admin assistant. If chaos calms down when you log in, keep reading.



What you'll own:



*Managing and training the other VAs in the office



*Assigning daily tasks to the VA team and tracking where the hours go — yours included — so we always know what our time is producing



*Weekly reports — churn, revenue vs. schedule, overtime, past-dues — and telling the owner what the numbers actually mean



*Running a weekly meeting rhythm — leading the VA team meeting and a weekly report/review with the owner, with agendas and action items that actually get followed up



*Preparing payroll and reviewing timecards



*Supporting hiring — posting ads, screening, scheduling interviews, onboarding



*Workforce planning — seeing the busy season coming and telling the owner how many people we'll need before we're short



*Sales tracking and coaching — setting goals, monitoring estimates, follow-ups, and conversion rates, and training the VAs to sell and upsell on calls



*Daily dispatch and routing for multiple crews — and reworking the schedule same-day when weather or call-outs hit



*Scheduling recurring services, skips, cancellations, reschedules



*Customer issue resolution — complaints, service recalls, keeping clients from cancelling



*Reviewing time-on-site and job profitability — catching jobs that run long or are priced wrong



*Invoicing, past-due follow-up, and collections



*Implementing annual price increases — identifying which customers are due, updating their pricing, and notifying them



*Tracking supplies and inventory, reordering before we run out, and keeping receipts/expenses organized for clean job costing



*Managing automations and service notifications in our software — and troubleshooting with the software provider when something breaks



*Writing SOPs so nothing lives in one person's head



*Winter projects — reviewing the year's numbers and setting goals and targets with the owner for the year ahead



*Helping build what's next as we grow — automations, dashboards, better systems, and bringing your own ideas to improve the business once you know how we run. We want someone who suggests things, not just waits for instructions.



The goal is simple: you run the backend so the owner can focus on growing the business. (Still reading? Good — start the first line of your application with the word "SHARP" so we know you read the whole post.)



Requirements:



*2+ years running operations/dispatch for a home service company (lawn care, pest, cleaning, HVAC, plumbing)



*Direct lawn care or weed control industry experience is a huge plus



*Field service software experience — Service Autopilot a big plus (ServiceTitan, Real Green, Jobber, Housecall Pro similar)



*Experience with EOS/Traction or 
 is a plus



*Strong with reports and spreadsheets — you can pull data and tell me what it means



*Strong written and spoken English; comfortable on client calls



*Fast communicator — you acknowledge messages same day, even if the answer is "working on it"



*Dual monitors, fast internet, quiet workspace



*Available 30–40 hours/week depending on season, during U.S. Central business hours — exact schedule discussed at interview



Pay: $6–9/hr depending on experience.



How to apply: answer these in a 2-3 minute video:



1. Biggest operation you've run — how many crews/techs and roughly how much revenue per week?



2. How do you plan ahead — how would you look 2 weeks to a month out to keep crews full and overtime down?



3. Show us your monitors and workstation on camera, and give us one reason we'd be crazy not to hire you.



Shortlisted candidates will be asked for 1-2 examples of reports or dashboards they've built, so have those ready.



Video requirements: record a NEW video for this application and make sure the link is open-access (no permission requests). Recycled videos with 10+ views will not be considered.



Applications without the video or the word get deleted.

title: Operations & Media Specialist
description:
About Kipkeh Media



Kipkeh Media runs a leading communication media channel and digital media brand serving the Orthodox Jewish community. We produce and publish high-engagement daily video stories, graphics, and frame content on a strict, time-sensitive publishing cadence.



The Standard We Expect



We run a structured, fast-moving operation. This role is strictly for focused professionals who take genuine ownership of their day-to-day workflow.

We do not hire passive task-takers who wait around to be told what to do, clock in without focus, or let assignments slide because a deadline is set for tomorrow instead of today. If you need daily micromanagement, multiple follow-up reminders to finish assigned work, or plan on multitasking several other full-time clients during your shift, do not apply.



At $4.00 – $5.00/hour (based on experience), we provide steady, 40-hour guaranteed weekly pay and long-term stability. In return, we expect absolute dependability, proactive communication, and zero dropped balls.



2-Week Paid Trial Period

Every new hire begins with an intensive 2-week paid evaluation trial at the agreed rate ($4.00 – $5.00/hr based on experience, 40 hrs/week).



This trial is designed to test your real-world work habits, not just what is written on your resume. During these two weeks, you will be evaluated specifically on:



Proactivity & Initiative: Do you follow up on tasks without being reminded? Do you ask clarifying questions before getting stuck?

Punctuality & Presence: Are you logged in on time, responsive on Slack throughout your shift, and delivering clean shift handoffs?

Tracking & Admin Discipline: Are Google Workspace sheets, pipelines, and status fields updated consistently in real time?

Quality & Speed: Are your video cuts and daily frame preparations accurate, clean, and delivered promptly?

Passing the 2-week trial transitions you directly into an ongoing, long-term full-time position. Candidates who show up passively, miss deadlines, or wait to be micromanaged will be let go before the trial concludes.

title: Finance Team Lead
description:
About us 



CSC Group Australia manufactures and distributes heavy truck parts and accessories. We have sites in Penrith and Richmond, New South Wales, and a growing remote finance team in the Philippines. 



About the Role 



We are looking for an experienced Finance Team Lead to manage our finance team and take ownership of day-to-day finance operations. 



You will lead the monthly close, ensure our financial records are accurate, reporting is delivered on time and compliance obligations are met. 



You will be confident resolving day-to-day finance issues independently, escalating only material risks, exceptions and decisions to the CFO. 



What You Will Do 



Own the month-end close, including journals, accruals, provisions, balance sheet reconciliations and intercompany transactions. 



Prepare monthly management reports, investigate variances and explain financial performance. 



Oversee inventory accounting, including stock valuations, reconciliations and cost of sales. 



Manage Australian tax compliance and statutory obligations, including GST, BAS, PAYG and payroll tax. 



Maintain and review the rolling 13-week cash flow forecast and monitor working capital. 



Oversee trade finance facilities, import financing, repayments and reconciliations. 



Review payroll, supplier payments, international transactions and foreign currency movements. 



Oversee accounts payable, receivable, customer credit controls and account reconciliations. 



Work with Procurement and Operations to resolve purchase order, inventory and invoicing discrepancies. 



Lead, coach and develop the finance team, including running weekly team meetings. 



Support the CFO with budgeting, forecasting and process improvements. 



What Success Looks Like 



Month-end is completed within 10 business days, with accurate supporting reconciliations. 



Financial reports are reliable, with clear explanations of material variances. 



Inventory and balance sheet discrepancies are identified and resolved promptly. 



Cash flow forecasts and trade finance obligations are accurately maintained. 



The finance team meets deadlines and resolves routine issues without unnecessary escalation. 



What You Will Bring 



A degree in Accounting or Finance, with at least 5 years' relevant experience. 



Strong experience in month-end close, financial reporting and balance sheet reconciliations. 



Experience supervising finance staff or managing a finance function. 



Inventory accounting experience, ideally in manufacturing, wholesale or distribution. 



Advanced Excel skills and experience with accounting or ERP systems. 



Excellent written and spoken English, strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently. 



A reliable internet connection and suitable home working environment. 



Highly regarded: Australian accounting and tax experience, CPA qualification, MYOB Acumatica, Xero Payroll, trade finance and foreign currency transactions. 



How to Apply 

Please submit: 



1. Your CV outlining your relevant experience. 



2. A 60-second Loom video introducing yourself, summarising your experience and explaining why you're interested in the role. 



3. Brief answers to the following questions: 



Describe your experience managing month-end close. How long did it take, and what were you personally responsible for? 



Tell us about a difficult balance sheet or inventory reconciliation you resolved. How did you identify and correct the issue? 



Which accounting systems have you used, and have you worked with Australian businesses?

title: Social Media & Creator Partnerships Coordinator
description:
SOCIAL MEDIA & CREATOR PARTNERSHIPS COORDINATOR



Company: Mintello Cards

Location: Remote

Employment: Part-Time | 15 hours per week

Starting Pay: $5 USD/hour

Growth: Performance review after the first 60 days, with opportunities for raises and expanded responsibilities

Start Date: Must be available to begin within 7–12 days of selection



ABOUT MINTELLO



Mintello Cards is a U.S.-based personalized gifting brand that transforms photos, memories, and stories into premium custom trading cards and playing card decks.



Our products are designed for birthdays, weddings, families, celebrations, creators, teams, and businesses.



We're building a recognizable consumer brand and looking for a creative, organized, and proactive Social Media & Creator Partnerships Coordinator to help grow our online presence.



This role combines two important responsibilities: managing Mintello's social media content and developing relationships with creators who can showcase our products to new audiences.



We're looking for someone who can bring ideas, take ownership, and help build something meaningful—not someone who simply schedules posts or sends generic influencer messages.



WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT



- Help manage Mintello's Instagram, TikTok, and other approved social platforms.

- Plan and maintain an organized weekly content calendar.

- Create engaging posts, carousels, stories, and short-form video content using Canva, CapCut, or similar tools.

- Edit and repurpose approved creator videos, product footage, and customer content.

- Write engaging captions, hooks, and calls to action that fit our brand.

- Research relevant trends and develop creative content ideas.

- Schedule posts and maintain a consistent publishing routine.

- Monitor engagement and respond to basic comments or messages using approved guidelines.

- Track content performance and identify opportunities to improve reach and engagement.



CREATOR & INFLUENCER PARTNERSHIPS



- Research Instagram and TikTok creators whose audiences align with Mintello.

- Identify promising micro-influencers in gifting, lifestyle, family, events, entertainment, and related niches.

- Evaluate creators based on content quality, audience relevance, and authentic engagement.

- Prepare and send personalized collaboration messages.

- Coordinate product gifting, barter collaborations, and approved paid partnerships.

- Track responses, collaboration agreements, product deliveries, posting schedules, and content deliverables.

- Follow up with creators and help maintain long-term partnerships.

- Organize creator-generated content for approved marketing use.



MARKETING COORDINATION



- Maintain accurate content and creator tracking records.

- Coordinate with management on upcoming promotions, product launches, and campaigns.

- Use AI tools to support research, content planning, and productivity.

- Provide concise weekly reports covering content published, creator outreach, partnerships, and results.

- Suggest new ideas and improvements based on actual performance.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Experience managing social media accounts for a business or brand.

- Experience researching or contacting influencers and content creators.

- Strong Canva skills and basic short-form video editing ability.

- Good understanding of Instagram, TikTok, Reels, and current social media content formats.

- Excellent written English and professional communication.

- Ability to create engaging captions and personalized outreach messages.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Comfortable using Google Sheets, AI tools, and content scheduling platforms.

- Ability to manage multiple ongoing tasks independently.

- Reliable availability for 15 hours per week.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- Experience coordinating influencer gifting or creator collaborations.

- Experience growing social media accounts for e-commerce or consumer brands.

- Familiarity with CapCut, Meta Business Suite, TikTok, Canva, or similar platforms.

- Experience producing content for U.S. audiences.

- Basic understanding of social media analytics and content performance.

- Experience organizing user-generated content and creator campaigns.



COMPENSATION & GROWTH



- Starting pay: $5 USD per hour.

- Approximately 15 hours per week.

- Performance review after the first 60 days, with eligibility for a raise based on results, reliability, initiative, and overall contribution.

- Opportunities to increase responsibilities and potentially expand working hours as the business grows.

- Long-term growth potential into a larger marketing coordination or management role.



You'll work directly with Mintello's leadership team and have the opportunity to influence how a growing brand develops its social media presence and creator community.



We value people who take initiative, communicate clearly, and consistently deliver quality work.



All paid creator partnerships, product gifting expenses, and other marketing spending require management approval. You will coordinate these activities but will not independently authorize payments.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the exact words:



Mintello Social



Then answer these questions:



1. Describe your experience managing social media accounts. Which platforms and brands have you worked with?



2. Share one example of a social media account or campaign you helped grow. What specific results did you achieve?



3. Describe your experience finding, contacting, or managing influencers and creators. How many collaborations have you helped coordinate?



4. If you were managing Mintello's Instagram and TikTok, what three content ideas would you suggest to help attract customers?



5. Write a short personalized collaboration message you would send to a micro-influencer introducing Mintello.



6. Share your portfolio or examples of social media posts, short-form videos, Canva designs, or creator campaigns you've worked on.



7. Confirm that you accept $5/hour for 15 hours per week, your preferred schedule, and whether you can begin within 7–12 days of selection.



We prioritize thoughtful applications, strong communication, relevant work samples, and demonstrated results.



Shortlisted candidates may complete a brief practical assessment.



We're excited to find someone who can help build Mintello's social media presence and creator partnerships as we grow.

title: Part-Time Sales & Marketing Strategist – Own How We Grow
description:
We are a U.S.-based managed services, web development, hosting, and colocation company serving small and mid-sized businesses. We do good technical work. We need someone who can turn that into a repeatable flow of qualified clients. You will own sales and marketing strategy for the business: who we target, what we say, which channels we use, and how we measure whether it’s working. You will then help put that plan into action.



We run lean. Your compensation and our marketing spend come from the same budget, so every dollar has to earn its place. This role is ideal for a strategic thinker who likes to execute. You can build a plan, defend it with numbers, and get results from low-cost channels before asking for paid ones.



Responsibilities



Define and refine our ideal customer profiles, positioning, and core messaging across our service lines (managed IT, web development, hosting, colocation)

Build and own a quarterly sales and marketing plan: channel mix, campaigns, targets, and a spend plan that fits a tight budget

Prioritize low-cost, high-return channels first, such as outbound, referrals, partnerships, SEO, content, and local networking. Recommend paid spend only when the numbers justify it

Design outbound and inbound lead generation programs, using our existing lead database and marketing analytics

Set up and maintain the pipeline process: lead stages, follow-up cadences, and handoff to sales and technical teams

Track performance (leads, conversion, cost per acquisition, closed revenue, return on spend) and report on what’s working and what isn’t

Use our in-house AI tools and automation to produce content, analysis, and outreach without adding cost



Requirements



1+ years owning sales or marketing strategy for a B2B services business. MSP, IT, agency, or SaaS experience is strongly preferred

A track record of producing measurable pipeline or revenue on a limited budget. Be ready to show us the numbers and what it cost

Comfortable translating technical services into clear, business-focused value for non-technical buyers

Data-driven; you make decisions from metrics, not instinct alone

Self-directed and organized in a remote, async environment

Native or near-native English fluency, written and verbal

Familiarity with CRMs, Google Analytics, SEO tools, or marketing automation is a plus



Where This Can Go



This role starts at 8–10 hours per week. It is designed to grow with the results you deliver. As the revenue you generate grows, so does the budget, and you’ll have a direct say in how it’s used. That can mean:



More hours, up to a larger part-time or full-time role

A larger marketing budget to put to work

Performance-based upside tied to the revenue you bring in

Leading the sales and marketing function as we build it out, including future hires



Your growth here is limited by results, not by our org chart.



What This Is (And Isn’t)



This is a part-time contract role, roughly 8–10 hours per week to start. We’re looking for a long-term partner in how the business grows, not a short-term campaign. This is not a role for someone who needs a large ad budget to produce results. It is not a pure execution role where someone hands you a task list. It is also not a pure advisory role where you write a deck and walk away. You own the strategy, the spend, and the outcomes.



How to Apply



Put GROWTH102 in your subject line. Include one example of a sales or marketing plan you built, the result it produced, and roughly what it cost. Applications without all three will not be reviewed.

Honest, highly responsive, and capable of working independently.

title: Finance Assistant (Accounts Payable & Receivable)
description:
**About Sculpd**



Sculpd is on a mission to get people creating with their hands again. We make at-home craft kits that are beautiful enough to gift and relaxing enough that you lose track of time. With a community of over 1 million Sculpdors and a growing range of pottery, candle-making and paint kits, we sell through our own site, Amazon and major retailers across the US, UK, EU, Canada and Australia.



We're scaling quickly across new markets and channels, and we need our finance engine to keep up.



**The Role**



We're looking for a remote Finance Assistant to own accounts payable and accounts receivable across our businesses. You'll make sure suppliers, partners and contractors get paid accurately and on time, that our retail customers pay us on time, and that our books in Xero are clean, reconciled and ready for month-end.



This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You'll work remotely and directly with the founders, our operations team and our external accountants, and you'll have the room to build better processes as we grow, including using AI tools to automate the repetitive parts.



**What you'll own**



- Accounts payable: processing supplier, freight, 3PL and contractor bills in Xero, checking them against POs, contracts and rates, chasing approvals and preparing payment runs

- Accounts receivable: raising invoices to retail and wholesale customers, tracking remittances, chasing overdue balances and keeping the aged debtors report accurate

- Bank and payment reconciliations across multiple currencies and entities

- Supplier statement reconciliations and resolving queries and discrepancies

- Month-end support: accruals, prepayments, intercompany and balance sheet reconciliations for our accountants

- Expense and commission claims, checked against policy and agreements

- Keeping finance processes documented and improving them as you go



**You'll be great for this role if you:**



- Have 2+ years of hands-on AP and/or AR experience, ideally supporting US, UK or Australian companies (remote and VA experience welcome)

- Use Xero confidently day to day (QuickBooks or similar is fine if you learn fast)

- Have worked with multiple currencies and, ideally, more than one entity

- Are genuinely accurate: you notice when a number doesn't look right and you follow it to the bottom

- Are comfortable chasing people for money politely but persistently

- Like building systems and processes, and are curious about using AI to make finance work faster

- Write clear, professional English and are comfortable working async with a team across time zones

- Have a reliable internet connection and a backup plan for power or connectivity outages



**Details about the role**



- Fully remote. We're open to candidates in the Philippines, Latin America and South Africa

- At least 4 hours a day overlapping with US PST business hours

- Independent contractor role, paid in USD

- 20 to 40 hours a week

- $5 USD an hour

- A creative, ambitious team building something that makes a difference to our customers' lives

All applications must be made here: 



Please fill out the application found on this link to apply for the role. Without an application here, you will not be considered.

You’ll be working across multiple systems and communication channels, keeping track of what’s happening across different markets and jumping in when something needs attention. You’ll work closely with field operators and internal teams, make quick calls when issues come up, and speak directly with customers when needed. 



This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable making quick decisions, switching between different tools, and working with both internal teams and external customers. You’ll be working closely with U.S.-based field teams every shift, so previous experience supporting U.S. operations remotely is a strong plus. Since this function is still being built, you’ll also have a real opportunity to help shape the workflows, escalation paths, and processes that the team will use as it grows.



What You'll Do

- Monitor fleet activity and alert channels across multiple platforms and markets, tracking robot and vehicle locations, battery levels, active tasks, and delivery status.

- Own operational issues through resolution by identifying and prioritizing issues as they arise, including stalled or immobilized robots, unsafe conditions, missed tasks, and deliveries that fall off schedule.

- Contact the assigned field operator to resolve the issue, and follow established escalation procedures when they do not respond within the required timeframe.

- Coordinate backup coverage when the assigned operator is unavailable so that fleet operations continue without interruption.

- Continuously triage incoming alerts, messages, and fleet data, determining what requires immediate action and what can be handled through normal workflows.

- Prioritize and coordinate field service activity across markets, including battery swaps, robot recoveries, fleet interventions, and other service stops.

- Handle calls from drivers and supervisors on active runs who are unable to locate a delivery address or reach a customer, and resolve the issue on their behalf.

- Contact customers directly to confirm delivery locations, obtain access instructions, or complete a drop off.

- Document each i
, the actions taken, and any details relevant to future operations - such as gate codes, difficult access points, and recurring problem locations - and help pinpoint recurring patterns that can improve future workflows and customer technology.

- Contribute to the development of dispatch procedures, escalation paths, and operational documentation as the operation grows.

- Work across multiple customer platforms, dashboards, Slack channels, and internal tools, quickly building context even when information is spread across different systems.



What We're Looking For

- 3+ years of experience in dispatch, towing, fleet operations, transportation, delivery, or another fast-moving vehicle-based operations environment.

- At least 1 year of experience working directly with a startup is highly preferred

- Experience supporting U.S.-based companies, customers, drivers, operators, or field teams, preferably in a remote or offshore setup.

- Hands-on experience coordinating drivers, field workers, technicians, couriers, vehicles, deliveries, or other moving resources.

- Strong real-time problem-solving skills. You can assess a situation quickly, figure out what needs to happen, and take action without waiting to be told every step.

- Comfortable handling multiple tasks, systems, and communication channels at the same time, as well as piecing together information across multiple tools when troubleshooting an issue.

- Confident in communicating with customers, drivers, operators, and internal teams, including people you may be interacting with for the first time.

- Comfortable making outbound calls and speaking with unfamiliar customers, drivers, and operators in real time.

- Strong, natural English communication skills, both written and verbal.

- Strong documentation skills with the ability to clearly capture what happened, what was done, and what needs to happen next.

- Comfortable working with technology and learning unfamiliar platforms quickly.

- Able to stay calm, organized, and responsive when several time-sensitive issues happen at once.

- Comfortable working in a startup environment where processes and tools are still evolving.

- Available to work U.S.-aligned hours, including weekends or other coverage periods when needed.

- Reliable internet connection and a dependable work-from-home setup.



Salary and Benefits:

- Base salary: 55,000 PHP per month

- Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

- 100% Work From Home

title: Wildlife Video & Photo Editor — Social Media, YouTube & Meta Ad Creatives
description:
I run a travel company specialising in small-group wildlife and photography trips.



I am looking for a creative, reliable editor to turn my original wildlife footage and photographs into content for Instagram,
 and YouTube, including paid Meta advertising campaigns.



The content should showcase wildlife encounters, give potential guests a sense of our trips, and encourage enquiries and bookings while keeping a natural, authentic look.



You will work with me. I am looking for someone who can understand my visual style and build a consistent working relationship over time.



This role covers both video and photography. I need one person who can do both, so please only apply if you are comfortable in Adobe Photoshop and Lightroom Classic as well as in video editing.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Video

• Review footage, selecting the moments that carry the story.

• Edit short videos for Instagram Reels,
 Reels and YouTube Shorts.

• Edit longer YouTube videos with clear storytelling, thoughtful pacing and a strong opening.

• Create alternative openings, thumbnails and visual variations for testing.

• Improve colour, exposure, white balance and audio where needed.

• Add accurate English captions, subtitles and simple titles.

• Use natural sound and appropriately licensed music, including music cleared for advertising when required.



Photography

• Process my RAW wildlife photographs in Lightroom Classic for social media use.

• Keep colours natural and detail realistic. The focus is on natural, consistent edits delivered efficiently, rather than extensive fine-art retouching.

• Photoshop work where a frame needs it: cropping, straightening, selective adjustments, removing a distracting element, careful cleanup. Any removal of objects or changes to the scene require my approval.

• Animals and scenes must not be added, removed or altered without my approval.



Advertising and formats

• Create photo and video ad creatives for paid
 and Instagram campaigns.

• Prepare content for feeds, Stories, Reels and carousels.

• Adapt compositions for vertical, portrait, square and landscape without awkward cropping or losing important detail.

• Keep text, logos and key subjects within the safe areas for each placement.

• Create YouTube thumbnails, social media graphics and carousel layouts.

• Export using the right dimensions, resolution, file formats and compression settings.



General

• Keep source files, editable project files and final exports organised.

• Make revisions based on feedback.



VISUAL STYLE



I am looking for polished, engaging wildlife content with a natural feel.



You should know when a video needs energy and when an animal encounter needs time to unfold. Music, transitions and effects should support the footage rather than overwhelm it.



Photo editing should look natural. Avoid heavy sharpening, oversaturated colour and obvious retouching. A series posted together should look like it belongs together.



ESSENTIAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE



• A strong video editing portfolio covering both short-form and longer videos.

• Confidence using Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or comparable professional editing software.

• Proficiency in Adobe Lightroom Classic, including RAW processing and keeping a series of photographs consistent.

• Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, including layers, masks, adjustment layers and non-destructive editing.

• Demonstrable experience creating content for Instagram,
 and YouTube.

• Experience producing photo and video creatives for paid Meta advertising campaigns.

• A practical understanding of aspect ratios such as 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9, and when to use each.

• Familiarity with current platform specifications, safe areas, mobile readability and export requirements.

• The ability to adapt the same source material thoughtfully for different placements.

• Good written English for communication and accurate on-screen text.

• Reliable internet and a computer capable of handling high-resolution photographs and video files.

• Clear communication, good organisation and the ability to meet agreed deadlines.



Experience with wildlife, nature, travel or documentary content is a strong advantage.



Setting up or managing advertising campaigns is outside the scope of this role.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



This is a remote role.



We will begin with a small paid trial project at an agreed rate and with a clear time limit.



I review and approve all final content before publication.



All supplied photographs and footage are confidential and may not be published, shared or used in your portfolio without my written permission. Once we are working together I am happy to release selected pieces for your portfolio on request.



Deliverables include editable video project files and layered Photoshop files where applicable.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short introduction explaining why this role interests you.

2. Three relevant video examples, including one short social media video and one longer YouTube video.

3. Two or three edited wildlife or nature photographs, with the unedited originals if you have them.

4. Your availability and your rate.



Please start your message with the word LYNX so I know you have read this through.



Shortlisted applicants receive a small paid test: one Reel cut from my own footage, two alternative openings of the same clip, and five photographs processed from RAW, all from the same session so I can see how consistent the set looks. The fee and the time limit are agreed before you start.

title: Client Project Manager (Part-Time, US Hours)
description:
Visit this link for a video explanation of this role by Travis Rose:





ABOUT GROWING ROSES



Growing Roses is a consulting firm run entirely by Travis Rose in Dallas, TX. Travis helps companies across every industry and department — finance, legal, HR, operations, development, L&D — design and configure ClickUp around how they actually work.





THE ROLE



Title: Client Project Manager (contract, part-time, remote)

Hours: 20 hours/week

Schedule: Available for client calls 12:00–4:00 PM US Central, Monday–Thursday (2:00–6:00 AM Philippine time; 1:00–5:00 AM during US daylight saving time). Remaining ~4 hours flexible.

Pay: $1,000 USD/month, rising to $1,200/month after 90 days once the month-3 milestones are met, plus a 13th-month bonus each December

Type: Independent contractor, with intent to build a long-term relationship

Availability: As soon as possible





WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



Projects slow down when action items slip — both by Travis and his clients. Travis is strong at discovery and solution design, but weaker at follow-up and keeping many threads organized across projects. This role owns the follow-through so projects move faster and nothing falls through the cracks.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Attend all client calls live, with camera on

• Capture clear minutes and action items: who, what, by when

• Keep action items and meeting notes current in each client's ClickUp workspace

• Read back action items at the end of each call

• Open calls by following up on last meeting's items, including the uncomfortable ones

• Chase clients between meetings via
/ClickUp/Slack/etc. when they're blocking progress

• Keep a short cross-client list of what needs Travis's attention, and run a quick priority review with him after calls

• If time remains in the 20 hours after the above is accomplished, assist with admin tasks (logging time, calendar review, etc.)





FIRST 90 DAYS



• Month 1: Attend every call, write minutes and action items. Travis reviews them before they go out.

• Month 2: Run the action item read-back at the end of calls. Minutes go out without review.

• Month 3: Open calls with follow-ups and chase clients between meetings on your own.



These milestones can be met earlier based on Travis's discretion and trust. Pay increases to $1,200/month once Month 3 milestones are met.





WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



• 3+ years of project management or executive support, ideally with US clients

• Organized, deadline-driven, and proactive — you follow up without being reminded

• Able to proactively work 20 value-adding hours each week, even when project workload decreases

• Confident speaking up with senior client stakeholders

• Clear written and spoken English

• Comfortable learning unfamiliar industries quickly; you don't need to be an expert, just able to capture who, what, and by when

• ClickUp experience is a plus, not required

• Stable internet, a quiet workspace, and a reliable computer





SECURITY AND CONFIDENTIALITY



Our clients are security-conscious. You'll:

• Sign an NDA, a contractor agreement with IP assignment, and client NDAs where required

• Provide an NBI clearance before your start date

• Use a 1Password vault provided by Growing Roses for all credentials for this work

• Work browser-only, with nothing stored locally





HIRING PROCESS



1. Initial application — When you apply, include:

   • A link to your LinkedIn profile (preferred) or your résumé

   • A link to a video (Loom, Google Drive, or unlisted YouTube) of you answering the following in 5 minutes or less:

      a. Tell me about a time a project stalled because someone else wasn't delivering. What did you do?

      b. How do you keep track of action items across several projects at once?

      c. Our calls are 2–6 AM your time (1–5 AM during US daylight saving time). How would you make that work long term?

2. Interview with Travis (45 minutes, during the US Central meeting window)

3. Paid work sample ($25) — Watch an hour-long recorded client meeting and send the action items and a short summary.

4. References — Two, ideally past managers who can speak to meeting deadlines.

5. Paid trial week ($250) — Sign the NDA first, then attend real client calls, write minutes, and run one read-back.

6. Offer





SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



• Every client call ends with clear, confirmed action items

• Client action items stop slipping for weeks

• Travis's own commitments get done on time

• Travis spends less time organizing and more time solving problems



—



Thanks for reading! I look forward to your application.
