title: Amazon UK FBA Wholesale Sourcing & Supplier Development Specialist
description:
Amazon UK FBA Wholesale Sourcing & Supplier Development Specialist



We have been operating a growing Amazon UK business for four years, with online arbitrage forming a significant part of our success.

We are now looking to accelerate our growth by expanding our wholesale sourcing strategy, establishing official supplier accounts and developing long-term relationships with wholesalers, distributors and brands.

We are looking for an experienced Amazon FBA Wholesale Sourcing Specialist who can independently discover reliable suppliers, establish wholesale accounts and identify profitable products for Amazon UK.

Our priority is finding genuine wholesale opportunities that can generate consistent, repeatable profits rather than relying on widely used supplier platforms or one-off product deals.



This is not an entry-level position. We need someone with proven wholesale sourcing experience who can contribute from day one.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Discover reliable, lesser-known wholesalers, authorised distributors and potential direct brand suppliers.

- Research and contact suppliers to establish official wholesale accounts.

- Negotiate competitive pricing, minimum order quantities (MOQs) and trade terms where possible.

- Analyse wholesale catalogues to identify profitable products for Amazon UK.

- Evaluate product demand, competition, Buy Box history, pricing, ROI and potential risks.

- Assess actual profitability after Amazon fees, VAT, shipping and applicable import costs.

- Verify supplier legitimacy, product authenticity, restrictions and suitability for Amazon resale.

- Maintain supplier relationships and identify opportunities for repeat purchases and improved trade terms.

- Prepare wholesale purchase orders and coordinate supplier shipments to our UK prep centre following purchasing approval.

- Build a growing portfolio of profitable products from reliable wholesale suppliers.



We are particularly interested in sourcing opportunities that are not already heavily exploited by other Amazon sellers.



REQUIREMENTS



- Proven Amazon FBA Wholesale sourcing experience, particularly in the UK marketplace.

- Demonstrable experience discovering suppliers and successfully establishing wholesale accounts.

- Strong knowledge of wholesale sourcing methods, supplier research and account acquisition.

- Proficiency with Keepa, BuyBotPro (BBP), ScanUnlimited, Analyzer Tools or similar software.

- Understanding of Amazon fees, ROI, sales rank, Keepa charts, gating and intellectual property (IP) risks.

- Ability to assess supplier reliability, resale eligibility and realistic product profitability.

- Strong written English communication and negotiation skills.

- Excellent research, analytical and organisational skills.

- Ability to work independently, take initiative and deliver measurable results.

- Ability to take ownership of responsibilities, manage tasks and supplier relationships independently and resolve routine issues without constant supervision.

- Proactive approach to identifying opportunities, following up with suppliers and presenting well-researched solutions rather than simply reporting problems.

- Reliable internet connection and availability to work full-time.



We are not looking for beginners or candidates who require training in the fundamentals of Amazon Wholesale sourcing.



Additional advantages, but not requirements:



- Existing professional relationships with brands, wholesalers or authorised distributors.

- Experience establishing direct brand partnerships.

- Experience sourcing internationally and handling UK import considerations.

- Experience negotiating better wholesale pricing based on purchasing volumes.

- Experience managing wholesale purchasing, supplier orders, stock replenishment and deliveries to UK prep centres.

- Broader Amazon account management or operational experience.



PERFORMANCE AND GROWTH



We are looking for someone who can build a sustainable wholesale sourcing operation that generates consistent and increasing profitability.

We value the quality of supplier relationships, successful account openings and repeatable profitability over simply submitting large numbers of product leads.

While we offer a guaranteed fixed monthly salary, we are looking for people who consistently deliver measurable results and demonstrate continuous improvement. Long-term opportunities with our company will depend on your performance, initiative and ability to contribute to the growth and profitability of our business.

We understand that building successful wholesale relationships takes time and performance will be evaluated realistically, taking into account factors such as purchasing budgets, stock availability and market conditions.

We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate previous results and explain what they realistically believe they can achieve in this role.

We are looking for someone who can take genuine ownership of our wholesale sourcing operations, work independently and help us build a more efficient and scalable business. Our goal is to find someone who not only generates profitable opportunities but also reduces the need for day-to-day management involvement as our wholesale operations grow.

We believe that strong performance should be rewarded. Candidates who consistently establish valuable wholesale accounts and generate increasing, sustainable profits will have opportunities for salary increases and additional performance-based bonuses.



Our goal is to develop long-term working relationships with people who can grow alongside our business.



TO APPLY, PLEASE ANSWER THE FOLLOWING QUESTIONS



1. What experience do you have sourcing wholesale products for Amazon UK? Please describe your previous responsibilities and results.



2. Have you successfully opened official wholesale accounts with wholesalers, authorised distributors or brands for previous clients? Approximately how many accounts have you established and what results did they generate? Please provide examples where possible without disclosing confidential information.



3. Name your top 3 lesser-known wholesalers or authorised distributors that you believe could offer profitable sourcing opportunities for Amazon UK. Include their websites and briefly explain why you selected them. We are particularly interested in suppliers that are not widely used by Amazon sellers, so please avoid popular platforms such as Qogita, BigBuy or similar commonly recommended wholesalers. We only expect publicly available information, not confidential supplier details from previous clients.



4. What monthly sales revenue and net profit have products you sourced generated for previous clients? Were these results consistent? Please provide realistic examples or estimates if exact figures are confidential.



5. Based on your experience, what monthly net profit do you realistically believe you could generate from your sourced products after 2 months and after 6 months? How would you approach achieving these results and what assumptions are your estimates based on?



6. What methods do you use to discover new wholesalers and successfully establish official wholesale accounts? Which sourcing tools or subscriptions would you need us to provide and why? Do you also have experience managing wholesale orders, purchasing and supplier deliveries?



7. Our advertised starting salary range is $400 to $800 per month for working 8 hours per day, 5 days per week. What starting monthly salary would you consider fair and what previous experience, successful wholesale account openings or measurable sourcing results justify your expectations?



8. (Optional) Do you have existing brand relationships or know any brands that might be interested in partnering with an established Amazon UK seller, either now or in the future? Please provide examples if possible. This is considered an advantage, not a requirement.



9. Why do you believe you are the right person to help take our Amazon UK business to the next level? This is your opportunity to demonstrate what makes you stand out from other applicants. We want to understand your strongest capabilities, previous achievements and the specific value you believe you could bring to our company. Explain how your experience, sourcing strategies, supplier acquisition skills and commercial knowledge could help us significantly expand our wholesale operations and increase long-term profitability. We encourage you to explain your ideas in detail where appropriate, but please remember that we value the quality and substance of your answer over its length. Specific examples, measurable achievements and practical ideas are far more valuable to us than lengthy generic statements. title: Experienced Property Management Virtual Assistant / Assistant Property Manager — U.S. Rentals
description:
Experienced Property Management Virtual Assistant / Assistant Property Manager — U.S. Rentals



We are a growing U.S. residential real-estate company looking for an experienced Property Management Virtual Assistant / Assistant Property Manager for a long-term, full-time position.



We currently manage approximately 60–70 residential rental units, primarily small multifamily and single-family properties in New York and New Jersey.



This is not a basic VA position.



We are looking for someone who already understands U.S. residential property management and can gradually become a key person responsible for keeping the day-to-day property-management operation organized and moving.



The right person should not need to be reminded repeatedly about unfinished tasks. We need someone who follows up, communicates, keeps good records, and makes sure important issues do not fall through the cracks.



Main Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include:



- Communicating directly with tenants by phone, text, and

- Receiving and managing maintenance requests

- Coordinating plumbers, electricians, HVAC contractors, handymen, and other vendors

- Scheduling repairs and tenant access

- Following maintenance issues until they are actually completed

- Keeping tenants updated

- Following up on unpaid rent and tenant balances

- Reviewing tenant ledgers and payment issues

- Leasing and application follow-up

- Responding to rental leads and scheduling showings

- Lease renewals

- Inspection scheduling and follow-up

- Section 8 / housing inspection coordination when applicable

- Move-in and move-out coordination

- Updating property-management records

- Tracking deadlines and open items

- Following up with vendors, tenants, and management

- Making sure unfinished items have a clear next step



Maintenance Experience Is Important



A major part of this position involves maintenance coordination.



We are especially interested in candidates who have personally handled maintenance issues from the tenant's first report through final completion.



You should be comfortable communicating directly with contractors, arranging access, following up repeatedly when necessary, keeping the tenant informed, and confirming that the repair was actually completed.



Experience personally finding new vendors and comparing pricing is a strong advantage.



Rent Manager Experience



We currently use Rent Manager.



Candidates with strong hands-on Rent Manager experience will receive preference.



Experience with AppFolio, Buildium, Rentvine, Propertyware, Yardi, or similar U.S. property-management software is also valuable.



Please be honest about which systems you have personally used and what responsibilities you handled inside them.



Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



- Has real U.S. residential property-management experience

- Is comfortable speaking with tenants on the phone

- Has strong written and spoken English

- Has experience coordinating maintenance and vendors

- Understands rent, tenant balances, leases, and basic property-management workflows

- Is organized and strong with follow-up

- Can manage multiple open items at the same time

- Documents work properly

- Communicates problems early

- Does not disappear when something becomes difficult

- Can work independently after learning our procedures

- Is comfortable reminding management when an important answer or decision is still needed

- Takes ownership of responsibilities instead of waiting to be reminded

- Is looking for a stable, long-term position



Experience as an Assistant Property Manager, Property Manager, Maintenance Coordinator, Leasing Coordinator, or Property Management Specialist is especially relevant.



Work Schedule



- Full-time

- Monday through Friday

- U.S. Eastern Time business hours

- Approximately 40 hours per week, with occasional additional time when genuinely needed

- Long-term position



Occasional emergency availability outside normal hours may be needed, with reasonable notice and expectations.



During agreed working hours, we expect this position to receive your full attention and not overlap with another full-time job.



Compensation



Compensation will depend on your actual experience, Rent Manager knowledge, property-management background, and ability to take responsibility independently.



Please include your realistic expected monthly salary for full-time work in your application.



There is opportunity for increased responsibility and compensation as you demonstrate value and grow with the company.



How to Apply



Please begin your application with:



BLUE DOOR



This helps us know that you read the entire job description.



Then answer the following questions:



1. How many years have you worked with U.S. residential property-management companies?



2. Which states were the properties located in, and approximately how many units or properties did you help manage?



3. Which property-management software have you personally used? If you have used Rent Manager, tell us for approximately how long.



4. Briefly describe what you personally did during a normal day in your most recent property-management position.



5. Did you personally communicate with tenants by phone, text, and
?



6. Did you personally coordinate maintenance with outside contractors/vendors? Did you ever personally find new vendors?



7. Which of the following have you personally handled: rent follow-up, tenant ledgers, applications, leasing, renewals, inspections, maintenance, move-ins/move-outs?



8. Are you currently working for another company? If yes, what hours do you currently work?



9. Are you available to work full-time during U.S. Eastern Time business hours?



10. What is your expected monthly salary for this position?



11. Briefly describe your computer, primary internet connection, backup internet, and backup power plan.



12. Please include a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and briefly describing your property-management experience.



If you reach the final stage of the hiring process, we may also request contact information for a former direct supervisor who can verify your employment and responsibilities.



About the Position



We do not expect a new hire to know our properties or our company's procedures immediately.



We will train the right person on our portfolio and the way we operate.



However, we are looking for someone who already understands property management itself and can eventually become a dependable person who helps keep the entire daily operation under control.



For the right person, our goal is a stable, long-term working relationship with increasing responsibility as the company grows.

title: Sales Coordinator
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an organized, service-oriented Sales Coordinator to serve as the first point of contact for inbound sales inquiries. You will welcome callers, capture accurate information, and connect them with the appropriate sales agent based on location. This role supports a smooth handoff from inquiry to sales follow-up; closing sales and enrolling callers remain the responsibility of sales agents.



Reporting and Collaboration

Department: Revenue Team

Reports to: Director of Revenue

Works with: Sales Managers, the Business Development Representative (BDR), field agents, and Finance.



Key Responsibilities

Answer inbound sales calls professionally and collect each caller's name,
 address, and location.

Prioritize live transfers to the appropriate sales agent based on the caller's location.

When a live transfer is not possible, bring the relevant Sales Manager or agent into a speaker or conference call.

Set clear expectations for when the caller can expect a sales agent to follow up.

Log every call and all required caller details in GoHighLevel (GHL) on the same day.

Follow the location-to-agent routing list to ensure inquiries reach the correct sales contact.

Maintain accurate intake records to support visibility into transfers, callbacks, and call-to-booking results.



Skills for Success

Clear verbal and written communication and a professional, welcoming phone manner.

Strong attention to detail when collecting caller information and updating records.

Ability to manage inbound inquiries, follow routing procedures, and coordinate handoffs.

Comfort using CRM systems and learning GoHighLevel (GHL).

Reliable follow-through and the ability to work collaboratively with sales teams.



How Success Is Measured

Inbound calls are answered and logged in GHL on the same day.

Caller name,
 address, and location are captured on every call.

Live transfer rate: the share of calls connected to a sales agent in real time versus routed for callback.

Callback expectations: sales agent follow-up occurs within the window communicated to the caller.



Your First 90 Days

First 30 days: Shadow the current call-intake process, learn the location-to-agent routing list, and begin logging every call in GHL under supervision.

By day 60: Manage call intake independently and meet live-transfer and logging expectations across a full week's call volume without correction.

By day 90: Take full ownership of the intake queue and provide the Director of Revenue with an initial review of the call-to-booking numbers being tracked.



Role Scope

The Sales Coordinator owns call intake, information capture, routing, and callback communication. Sales agents own closing and enrollment. Sales Managers own agent performance and scheduling.

title: Photo QC & Delivery Coordinator (Real Estate Media, PH Daytime Hours)
description:
LOCATION: Remote, Philippines preferred



TYPE: Full-time contractor, 5 shifts a week (Sunday night to Thursday night US Eastern), 10:00pm to 7:00am Eastern. That's about 11:00am to 8:00pm Philippine time, so it's a daytime shift for you.



PAY: $800 USD per month



THE ROLE

We're looking for a detail-obsessed Photo QC & Delivery Coordinator to work while our US team sleeps. Every day's shoots get checked, fixed, and ready overnight, so when our team starts its morning, every order is ready to send. You'll QC and deliver our photo-only orders, prepare our video and premium orders so they're ready to send, and keep our editors moving so no revision ever slips.



You'll work side by side with our Project Coordinator, who handles the phone and client relationships. Your job is to make sure everything behind the scenes is done, checked, and ready, so our clients get their media fast and get it right the first time.



WHO WE ARE

Bluegrass Real Estate Media is a full-service real estate media company based in Lexington, Kentucky. We produce photography, video, drone, 3D tours, floor plans, listing websites, and branding content for real estate agents across Central Kentucky. Our project managers, creatives, and editors work as an extension of our clients' teams.



We're built on relationships and a refusal to stand still. We keep innovating so that marketing is never the reason our client loses a sale.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

First half of your shift: QC and delivery

• QC every photo from the day's shoots inside AutoHDR, our AI photo editing platform, and fix what needs fixing yourself in Photoshop (verticals, window pulls, color casts, object removal) or send it back to editors.

• Get photo-only orders fully ready to deliver, with the delivery message written and scheduled to reach the client in the morning.

• Prepare video and premium orders for delivery: photos checked, floor plans, silos, and 3D links in place, and the delivery message drafted for final review.

• Hit our standard: every order from the day before is ready by 7:00am Eastern.



Middle of your shift: editor coordination

• Send client revisions to our editors with clear, specific notes.

• Check every edit when it comes back before it goes to the client.

• Follow up on anything running late until it's done.



End of your shift: order prep and the morning handoff

• Review the next day's orders in Tonomo and make sure each one has the right services and details.

• Queue invoice reminders so clients pay before their shoot.

• Leave our Project Coordinator a short morning handoff: what's ready, what's waiting on editors, and anything that needs a human call.

• Share agent on-camera scripts with our photographers ahead of their shoots.

• Draft client messages to send during US business hours, and handle Zillow Showcase uploads and MLS-sized exports.



Growth support

• Send review requests to happy clients.

• Keep client records up to date in our CRM.

• Tag our best photos in Dropbox for social media content.

• Pull client lists for anniversary messages and check-ins.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Hands-on Photoshop experience (required). You'll be retouching and fixing real estate photos yourself: verticals, window pulls, color correction, sky replacement, object removal.

• Willingness to work inside AutoHDR every day. It's the AI editing platform our photos run through, and you'll learn it in your first week if you haven't used it.

• Experience in real estate photo editing, photo QC, or as a virtual assistant for a real estate or media company.

• An eye for detail. You notice a crooked vertical, a blown-out window, or a missing room before anyone else does.

• Strong written English. You'll write messages that go directly to our clients.

• Organized and reliable. You finish what you start and never let a follow-up slip.

• Comfortable with tools like Dropbox, Slack, and Google Workspace, and quick to learn new ones.

• Reliable high-speed internet, a quality computer, and a quiet place to work.

• Available for the full shift, 10:00pm to 7:00am US Eastern (about 11:00am to 8:00pm Philippine time), Sunday night to Thursday night Eastern.



BONUS POINTS

• Experience with AutoHDR or Lightroom.

• Experience with Tonomo, Aryeo, HDPhotoHub, or similar real estate media platforms.

• Experience with GoHighLevel or another CRM.

• Experience working with US clients.



TOOLS YOU'LL USE

AutoHDR, Photoshop, Tonomo, Dropbox, Slack, Google Workspace, Matterport, and our internal operations dashboard.



HOW TO APPLY

A recorded video response is required for every application. Applications submitted without a video will not be reviewed.



Apply here: 



The application takes about 10 minutes plus a short video (3 to 6 minutes, in English) where you answer 5 questions. Please also upload your resume. When you apply here on OnlineJobs, start your message with the words "Bluegrass QC" and include a link to your completed application.



Top applicants will complete a short, paid test project: reviewing a real photo shoot, catching any issues, writing the client delivery message, and writing an edit note for our editors.



HOW IT WORKS

• Paid monthly in USD through Deel or Wise.

• Starts with a 2-week paid trial.

• Independent contractor agreement.

• Room to grow as our company grows.



Bluegrass Real Estate Media welcomes applicants of every background and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, or any other protected status.

title: Full-Time Real Estate Photo Editor (Quality Control Auto HDR Specilaist)

You’ll also handle drone property lines, so you must be able to draw clean and accurate outlines that match our style. The shift includes editing twilight photos, drone photos, interior/exterior HDR sets, and completing revision requests before 9 AM EST.



Required skills:

– Real estate photo editing

– Photoshop object removal

– AutoHDR/AI workflow

– Hand-blending HDR brackets

– Twilight edits (virtual + real)

– Drone property line editing

– Strong QC and consistency



Please apply with real estate samples, Photoshop removal examples, HDR edits, and confirmation that you can work the overnight shift.

title: Staff Accountant, Franchise Clients (PTO, 13th Month, Equipment Stipend)
description:
Full time. $2,500 to $4,000 USD a month, set by seniority and experience.



At most firms, a franchise client is one more file in a pile of dentists and contractors. At Monterra, franchise clients are the whole job. If you already know how a restaurant group closes its books, with food cost by store, royalty drafts every period and a calendar that never matches the month, this is a place where that knowledge is the point, not a footnote on your resume.



Why people take this job



• One specialty, done well. We serve franchise owners, and most of them run food-service groups with several locations. You get good at one kind of book instead of starting from scratch with every client.

• A reviewer in your corner. A senior accountant reviews every close you finish and sends the report to the client. You get real feedback on your work, and your day goes to the accounting instead of the inbox.

• AI on live work, early. We are rolling AI tools out across the firm. You will use them on real closes, find where they go wrong and help shape how we use them.

• A firm that keeps its clients. Monterra has served business owners since 1991. Not one client has left us in the past year, and new clients sign with us every month.

• A hiring process that respects you. You are judged on a work sample you complete, not on keywords in your resume, and every applicant gets a reply.



What you will do



• Close the books every period for your set of franchise clients

• Reconcile every bank, card and merchant account

• Track inventory and food cost by location, and find out why when a number moves

• Book royalty and advertising fund fees

• Hand your reviewer a clean close, on time



What you need



Franchise client experience. This is the one requirement. You have done accounting work for businesses that pay royalties to a franchisor under a franchise agreement. A multi-location business without a franchise agreement does not count, and we make no exceptions.

You also need to be ready on day one. You know how a close works, and you can run one without anybody walking you through it.



Nice to have: 

13-period accounting, Thomson Reuters Accounting CS, multi-entity books, and hands-on use of AI tools in accounting work.

Not required: a degree, a licence, a particular title, a minimum number of years, or management experience.



Who fits here



You do not leave a reconciliation with a difference in it. When a close runs late, you stay and finish it, because the client is counting on it. You would rather be very good at franchise accounting than average at everything. You do not plug holes just to ship the numbers.



How hiring works



1. Application. About 15 minutes, in your own words. No cover letter.

2. Work sample. A period-end close for a made-up franchisee with three locations. About 90 minutes of work, with 72 hours to finish it. Every candidate gets different numbers.

3. Interview with the owner, about your work sample and your application.

4. References, only after a conditional yes, and only after we tell you.



You may use AI on your application and work sample if you tell us where and how, and you can explain every answer yourself. We check every application for AI use. If you use it and say you did not, your application ends. We also ask your references about the work you describe, so describe it accurately.



Apply at 
. It takes about 15 minutes. Do not apply through OLJ, only applications at that link will be considered.

title: U.S. Tax Accountant
description:
Join a Growing CPA & Advisory Firm Focused on Tax Strategy & Wealth Building



At Liger Zelaya Growth & Tax Advisors, we do more than prepare tax returns. We help business owners, high-income professionals, and real estate investors build long-term wealth through proactive tax planning, accounting, and strategic financial guidance.



We're a family-owned CPA and advisory firm led by Emma Liger Zelaya, CPA, and we're looking for an experienced U.S. Tax Accountant who wants to grow with us and become an integral part of our team.



This is a dedicated, long-term position for someone who is ready to commit their professional time and expertise to our firm. We are not looking for someone who plans to juggle multiple clients or split their working hours across different companies. We want someone who can become familiar with our clients, understand our processes, take ownership of their responsibilities, and grow alongside the firm.



If you enjoy solving complex tax challenges, exploring tax-saving strategies, and working directly with firm leadership, we'd love to meet you.



What You'll Do



- Prepare and review U.S. individual and business tax returns.

- Assist with proactive tax planning and strategic tax advisory engagements.

- Analyze financial information to identify tax-saving opportunities.

- Support multi-state tax compliance and reporting.

- Communicate with clients and assist with tax-related inquiries.

- Work closely with the firm's leadership on client engagements and special projects.

- Help improve internal workflows, processes, and systems as the firm continues to grow.



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone with at least 2–3 years of hands-on U.S. tax preparation experience, preferably with exposure to both individual and business tax returns.



Required Qualifications:

- At least 2–3 years of U.S. tax preparation experience.

- Hands-on experience with Form 1040, Schedule C, Schedule E, Form 1065, and Form 1120S.

- Solid accounting and tax fundamentals.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple client engagements and meet deadlines.

- Willingness to commit to a dedicated, full-time role with our firm.



Preferred Experience:

- QuickBooks, TaxDome, ATX, Drake, ProSeries, CCH, or Canopy.

- Tax research and tax planning tools such as TaxGPT or Juno.

- Experience supporting high-income individuals, business owners, and real estate investors.

- CPA or EA certification is a plus but not required.



Why Join Us?



This isn't your typical tax preparation job.



At Liger Zelaya, you'll have the opportunity to go beyond compliance work and become involved in meaningful tax planning and advisory engagements.



You'll work directly with experienced CPAs and firm leadership, gaining exposure to strategies that help clients make informed financial decisions and build long-term wealth.



We believe in investing in our people. As part of our team, you'll receive:



- Direct mentorship and guidance from experienced CPAs.

- Exposure to complex tax situations and proactive tax strategies.

- Opportunities to take ownership of client relationships and engagements.

- A supportive, family-run working environment.

- Professional development and opportunities to grow into greater responsibilities as the firm expands.



Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to build a career with us, not simply complete assignments and move on to the next client.



Compensation & Benefits



- Competitive compensation based on experience.

- Fully remote work environment.

- Dedicated, long-term position with our firm.

- Ongoing mentorship and professional development.

- Performance-based growth opportunities.

- Opportunity to grow with an expanding CPA and advisory firm.



Ready to Grow With Us?



If you have at least 2–3 years of U.S. tax experience and are looking for more than just another tax preparation job, we'd love to hear from you.



Join a growing firm where your expertise, commitment, and contributions can make a meaningful difference.

- Contract Management: Assist with sending contracts for electronic signatures using BoldSign.

- Social Media (Potential Responsibility): Help create content, schedule posts, and maintain an active social media presence.

- General Administrative Support: Assist with other tasks as needed to help the business operate efficiently.

- QuickBooks Online

- Google Drive and Google Workspace

- Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Word

- Social media content creation and posting is a plus



You do not need to know everything on day one! We value someone who is willing to learn, follow our processes, and grow with the company.



Qualities Needed



There are three important qualities we are looking for:

Integrity, Commitment, and Desire to Learn.



+ Integrity: You are a good fit if you are honest and communicate openly with your team members. If you cannot meet a deadline or make a mistake, be upfront about it. We understand that everyone is human, and we value honesty and accountability.



+ Commitment: We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship. This position will start part-time, with the potential to become full-time as the business grows. If you're only looking for a few months of work, this may not be the right opportunity for you.



+ Desire to Learn: We are a growing company, and we want someone who is excited to develop new skills and take on additional responsibilities. Initially, you'll follow assigned tasks and learn our systems. Over time, we want you to recognize the next steps in our processes and help keep things moving without constant reminders.



For example, when an estimate is sent to a customer, you'll eventually know when to follow up, document their response, and communicate any important updates to our team.

We understand that every business operates differently.



We will provide guidance and brief training on our processes, expectations, and the tools we use.



Our goal is to find someone who can start by assisting with assigned tasks and eventually become a dependable member of our team who understands how our business operates.

BookedAndAnswered works for small US home-service businesses (plumbers, HVAC, electricians, roofers, landscapers). You will call the owners of these businesses across the US, starting in Dallas-Fort Worth, show them what they lose to missed calls, and close a monthly plan ($249 to $799) on the call.



What you will do

- Call business owners from our CRM and dialer, US Central business hours (Monday to Friday, about 10:00 pm to 7:00 am Manila time).

- Close on the call: the customer pays through a secure payment link we text them. You never take or read card numbers.

- Book the customer's 48-hour onboarding call before you hang up.

- Follow our script, our Do Not Call rules and our recording rules on every call.



You have

- At least 2 years of outbound sales to US customers, with closing (not only appointment setting). Tell us your best month in closes.

- Excellent, natural spoken English and the confidence to talk to busy owners.

- Wired internet of 25 Mbps or more, a backup connection, backup power, a USB noise-cancelling headset and a quiet room.



Pay

- PHP 30,000 a month base, paid weekly through Payoneer.

- $50 for every close, paid once the customer's first payment clears and their onboarding call has happened. A close that cancels within 30 days is taken back.

- Independent contractor. Top closers move to a higher base.



How to apply (applications without these are not read)

1. A 60 to 90 second voice recording: your name and city, your internet speed and backup plan, then read this opener as if on a live call: "Hi, this is [your name] calling from BookedAndAnswered. Is this the owner? I'll be quick: when you're on a job and your phone rings, who answers it?"

2. A screenshot of a speed test from the computer you will work on.

3. Your best month in closes, and what you sold.



Next steps: a shortlist within 48 hours, a 15-minute mock call with a tough owner, then an offer. Start date in November, confirmed at offer; your first 3 nights of live calls are a paid trial, and the ones who close stay.



Rules: calls go only through our recorded dialer, numbers on Do Not Call lists are never called, and you sign our calling-rules acknowledgment before your first call.

title: Business Development / Lead Generation Specialist
description:
# BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & LEAD GENERATION SPECIALIST



**Company:** IIS Enterprises LLC  

**Industry:** Temporary Housing / Insurance Housing / Corporate Housing  

**Work Arrangement:** Remote  

**Schedule:** Full-Time  

**Target Hiring Market:** Philippines  

**Reports To:** CEO / Business Development Manager  

**Website:** 



## ABOUT IIS ENTERPRISES LLC



IIS Enterprises LLC provides temporary housing solutions for individuals, families, insurance-displaced policyholders, corporate clients, relocation clients, and other organizations requiring flexible housing.



Our growth objective is to build a strong national network of insurance carriers, adjusters, restoration companies, temporary-housing vendors, relocation companies, corporations, property managers, landlords, and other referral and business partners.



We are looking for a highly motivated **Business Development & Lead Generation Specialist** who can help IIS consistently identify new opportunities, reach decision-makers, build relationships, and generate qualified temporary-housing business.



This is **not simply a data-entry or list-building position**. We need someone who is comfortable researching companies, calling prospects, sending professional
s, using LinkedIn, following up persistently, maintaining a CRM, and ultimately helping turn prospects into business relationships and housing opportunities.



# YOUR PRIMARY MISSION



Your mission is simple:



**Create qualified business opportunities that can generate temporary-housing claims, referrals, vendor relationships, and revenue for IIS Enterprises LLC.**



You will build and manage a consistent outbound business-development pipeline.



## WHO YOU WILL TARGET



Your prospecting priorities will be:



1. **Insurance Carriers**

2. **Independent Adjusters and CAT Adjusters**

3. **Restoration Companies**

4. **ALE and Temporary-Housing Vendors**

5. **Relocation Companies**

6. **Corporations and HR Departments**

7. **Healthcare and Traveling-Professional Organizations**

8. **Professional and Collegiate Sports Organizations**

9. **Government and Emergency-Housing Opportunities**



You may also identify additional markets that could generate profitable temporary-housing business for IIS.



# KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



## 1. Lead Generation & Prospect Research



Research and identify organizations that could become IIS customers, referral sources, vendors, or strategic partners.



You will:



- Build targeted prospect lists.

- Identify decision-makers and influencers.

- Find verified business phone numbers and
 addresses.

- Research company websites and LinkedIn profiles.

- Identify vendor-registration opportunities.

- Research insurance carrier procurement/vendor processes.

- Identify restoration companies in active markets.

- Research catastrophe-affected markets.

- Find corporate and relocation housing opportunities.

- Research potential strategic partnerships.

- Maintain accurate prospect information inside the IIS CRM.



The goal is not simply to produce large lists.



**The goal is to identify people and organizations capable of producing real business.**



## 2. Cold Calling



Conduct professional outbound calls to prospective partners and customers.



You will contact:



- Insurance executives

- Claims professionals

- Adjusters

- Vendor-management departments

- Procurement departments

- Restoration-company owners and managers

- Business-development executives

- ALE/housing companies

- Relocation companies

- Corporate HR departments

- Property managers

- Other potential referral partners



You must be comfortable speaking with decision-makers and asking intelligent business questions.



You will be provided with IIS scripts and training, but you must learn to have a natural business conversation rather than simply reading a script.



## 3. Cold
 Outreach



Create and send targeted outbound
 campaigns.



Responsibilities include:



- Personalizing
s.

- Sending initial introductions.

- Following up with prospects.

- Sending IIS marketing materials.

- Sending the IIS capabilities statement and brochure.

- Requesting vendor-registration information.

- Scheduling meetings.

- Tracking opens/replies where appropriate.

- Maintaining follow-up schedules.



Mass
ing without proper targeting or personalization is not the objective.



**Quality conversations and qualified opportunities matter more than meaningless activity.**



## 4. LinkedIn Business Development



Use LinkedIn to identify and connect with decision-makers.



You will:



- Research companies.

- Find relevant executives.

- Send personalized connection requests.

- Start professional conversations.

- Follow up with connections.

- Direct qualified prospects toward meetings with IIS management.

- Maintain professional communication representing the IIS brand.



## 5. Vendor Registration



Identify organizations where IIS could become an approved vendor or service provider.



Research and document:



- Vendor-registration website

- Application requirements

- Procurement contact

- Claims/vendor-management contact

- Required documents

- Insurance requirements

- W-9 requirements

- Registration deadlines

- Application status

- Follow-up dates



Assist IIS management with completing and tracking vendor applications.



## 6. Restoration Company Partnerships



Develop relationships with national, regional, and local restoration companies.



The objective is to position IIS as a temporary-housing resource when restoration customers cannot remain in their homes during mitigation, remediation, reconstruction, or repairs.



Research both:



- Large national restoration networks

- Independent local restoration companies



## 7. Catastrophe Market Research



Monitor potential housing-demand markets created by:



- Hurricanes

- Tornadoes

- Wildfires

- Flooding

- Severe storms

- Major fires

- Other disasters



When appropriate, identify:



- Affected cities

- Insurance activity

- Restoration companies

- Adjusters

- Housing availability

- Property-management companies

- Potential corporate-housing inventory

- Other organizations involved in recovery efforts



IIS wants to develop relationships **before, during, and after** major events—not wait until competitors have already entered the market.



## 8. CRM Management



All meaningful sales activity must be recorded in the IIS CRM.



Every prospect should include, when available:



- Company

- Contact

- Job title

- Phone

-

- Website

- Market

- Prospect category

- Date contacted

- Contact method

- Conversation notes

- Current housing process/vendor

- Opportunity

- Vendor-registration information

- Follow-up date

- Next action

- Meeting status

- Vendor status

- Claims received

- Placements generated

- Revenue generated



**If it is not documented in the CRM, IIS cannot properly manage or measure it.**



# DAILY WORKFLOW



A typical day may include:



**Morning**



Review follow-ups, priority prospects, new leads, catastrophe developments, and scheduled meetings.



**Prospecting Block**



Research new companies and decision-makers and add qualified prospects to the CRM.



**Outbound Block**



Conduct telephone calls, personalized
s, LinkedIn outreach, and follow-ups.



**Business Development Block**



Research vendor applications, restoration opportunities, carrier relationships, corporate prospects, and strategic partnerships.



**Follow-Up Block**



Follow up with prospects who previously expressed interest or requested information.



**End-of-Day Reporting**



Update the CRM and submit a concise report showing:



- Outbound activities

- Decision-makers reached

- Meaningful conversations

-
s sent

- LinkedIn contacts

- Follow-ups

- Meetings scheduled

- Vendor applications identified/submitted

- Qualified opportunities

- Claims/leads generated

- Problems requiring management attention



# PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



IIS intends to build toward a high-volume outbound operation, potentially approaching **150 quality outbound activities per day across calls,
s, LinkedIn, and follow-ups** once the employee is fully trained and the systems support that volume.



However, IIS does **not** measure success simply by counting calls.



Your performance will ultimately be judged by outcomes including:



- Qualified prospects

- Decision-maker conversations

- Meetings scheduled

- Vendor applications

- Vendor approvals

- Strategic relationships

- Qualified housing opportunities

- Claims received

- Placements generated

- Revenue and profit attributable to business development

- Follow-up consistency

- CRM accuracy

- Conversion rates



Someone making 150 poor calls without producing opportunities is not outperforming someone making fewer, better-targeted contacts that generate business.



# QUALIFICATIONS



We are looking for someone who has:



- Excellent spoken English

- Excellent written English

- Strong telephone communication skills

- Professional business communication

- Lead-generation experience

- Cold-calling experience

-
 outreach experience

- Online research skills

- LinkedIn prospecting experience

- CRM experience

- Strong organization

- Excellent follow-up habits

- Attention to detail

- Confidence speaking with executives

- Ability to work independently

- Ability to meet measurable performance goals



Experience in any of the following is highly desirable:



- B2B sales

- Appointment setting

- Insurance

- Property restoration

- Real estate

- Corporate housing

- Temporary housing

- Relocation

- Property management

- Hospitality

- Recruiting

- SaaS/business development

- Vendor management



Direct temporary-housing experience is helpful but **not required** if you are an excellent researcher, communicator, and business-development professional.



# TECHNOLOGY SKILLS



Candidates should be comfortable using or learning:



- 

- LinkedIn

- Google Workspace / Microsoft Office

- Business

- CRM platforms

- VoIP/business calling systems

- Online research tools

- Lead-generation platforms

- AI productivity tools

- Spreadsheets



# COMPENSATION



**Base Compensation:** Approximately **$175–$200 USD per week**, depending on experience and demonstrated capability.



**Performance Incentive:** Approximately **$125–$150 USD per successfully placed claim attributable to the employee**, subject to IIS's written attribution, eligibility, payment, compliance, and commission policies.



Compensation may be reviewed as the employee demonstrates consistent performance and produces measurable business results.



# TRAINING & PROBATION



The selected candidate will receive approximately **one week of paid initial training** covering:



- IIS Enterprises LLC

- Temporary housing

- Insurance-displacement housing

- Target customers

- Insurance terminology

- Restoration industry

- Prospect research

- Cold calling

-
 outreach

- LinkedIn outreach

- Vendor registration

- CRM management

- IIS scripts

- Objection handling

- Follow-up

- Performance expectations



The position will initially operate under a **30–60 day performance-review/probationary period**.



Performance standards will become increasingly conversion-based after IIS has sufficient operating data to establish realistic benchmarks.



# THE PERSON WE WANT



We are looking for someone who thinks:



**“How can I create an opportunity for IIS today?”**



You should be persistent without being unprofessional.



You should be comfortable hearing “no.”



You should know that many business-development opportunities require multiple follow-ups.



You should be curious enough to research a company before contacting it.



You should be organized enough to know exactly whom you need to follow up with tomorrow.



And you should be ambitious enough to want your work directly connected to the company's growth.



# CAREER GROWTH



This position is intended to become an important part of IIS Enterprises LLC's growth strategy.



A high-performing employee may have opportunities to advance into positions such as:



- Senior Business Development Specialist

- Business Development Team Lead

- Account Executive

- Strategic Partnerships Specialist

- Business Development Manager

- Sales Manager



Advancement will depend on performance, leadership ability, reliability, and measurable contribution to IIS growth.



# HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



1. Your resume.

2. A short description of your B2B lead-generation and cold-calling experience.

3. The CRM and lead-generation tools you have used.

4. Your experience using LinkedIn for prospecting.

5. Your experience scheduling meetings with business decision-makers.

6. Your internet speed and remote-work setup.

7. Your expected weekly compensation.

8. A **60–90 second voice recording** introducing yourself as if you were calling an insurance or restoration-company executive on behalf of IIS Enterprises LLC.



In your application, answer this question:



**If IIS asked you to find 25 restoration companies and the decision-maker at each company by tomorrow, explain exactly how you would do it.**



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.



**IIS Enterprises LLC**  

Temporary Housing Solutions

title: STR REVENUE MANAGER
description:

* Revenue per property

* Booking sources

### Market Research



* Monitor local competitors.

* Track local events affecting demand.

* Analyse seasonal trends.

* Monitor hotel pricing.

### Strategy



* Create pricing strategies for:



* Holidays

* Events

* Conferences

* School holidays

* Low season

* High season

* Recommend promotional campaigns.

* Help launch new properties with optimal pricing.



## KPIs



You will be measured on:



* Occupancy %

* ADR

* RevPAR

* Revenue growth

* Booking conversion rate

* Portfolio profitability

* Weekly reporting accuracy

* Speed of identifying opportunities

* Quality of recommendations



## Skills Required

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Highly analytical.

* Proactive problem solver.

* Confident making recommendations.

* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets.

* Experience with PriceLabs or equivalent.

* Ability to work independently.

* Excellent organisational skills.



## Bonus Skills



* Experience with Zeevou.

* Experience managing UK serviced accommodation.

* Knowledge of 
, Airbnb, Vrbo and direct booking channels.

* Experience with Google Looker Studio or Power BI.

* Basic SQL or data analysis skills.



## Working Hours



* Flexible with overlap into UK business hours.

* Daily portfolio review required.

* Weekly management meeting.

* Monthly performance review.

Please include:

- You shortlist; the owner hires. Never send offers, agree to pay, or share company account access, passwords or phone numbers.

title: Orthodontic Virtual Assistant (Remote -  $7 to $8 per hour)
description:
Dental office or practice experience required



Orthodontic Virtual Assistant. For someone whose voice makes a nervous parent smile before they ever walk through our door.



Our best days start with good music playing low and a phone that keeps ringing in the best way. Every caller

hears someone who sounds genuinely glad they called. By the end of the day, people who dialed in unsure have

a first visit on the calendar and are already looking forward to it. Nobody is rushing. Nobody sounds like they're

reading a script. Dr. B and the team are in sync, and the day moves like a great set: everyone knows their part,

and the whole room sounds better because of it. You'll be working virtually, but you are still part of that room.



We are small by choice. That means you will know our patients and families by name, they will know your voice,

and the people you work with will notice when you do something great and say so out loud. We're a brand new

practice in Green Hills, Nashville, and you will be one of the very first voices people hear. We're building

something we are really proud of, one great phone call at a time!



Everything we do runs on five values we call MAGIC: Mastery, Authenticity, Growth, Integrity, and Compassion.



They aren't a poster on the wall. They're how we show up for our patients and for each other, and they're what

we look for in every person who joins us.



Who thrives here

You're someone who lives our five values without being told, and who lights up when the phone rings:



Mastery. You take pride in a clean, well run schedule and a perfectly confirmed appointment, and you would

rather ask "why do we do it this way?" than guess. New software and a really good system give you a little

thrill, and insurance language sounds like something you'd enjoy learning, not something to fear.



Authenticity. You're the same warm, upbeat person on a call as you are with your best friend. Your energy

is natural, not performed. You can make a worried parent and a shy teenager both feel like the most

interesting caller of the day, and you tell the truth kindly, whether that's "that time is taken, but here's a great

option" or "here's what I'd do differently."



Growth. You're curious, you welcome change, and you hear "small team" and think "my ideas will be

heard," not "that sounds like a lot."



Integrity. You do the right thing when no one is watching. When you promise a callback, you call back. You

show up on time and ready because the first caller of the day is counting on you, and when you make a

mistake you say so and fix it.



Compassion. You can hear the worry in someone's voice and slow down before anyone asks you to. You

listen first, because every patient and family calls with different needs and different questions.

Your phone presence is the job. A caller meets us through your voice, and a warm, upbeat, confident

one is the best first impression we could ask for. If you light up on a call, we want to meet you.



Dental experience is required, and orthodontic experience is a bonus. Phone based customer service

experience helps too. Insurance experience is not required, because we will train you. Energy and heart are the

things we can't teach, and everything else we can. If you have both, we want to hear from you!



What you'll do

This role is more than scheduling. Here is what your days cover, and we will train you on the insurance side.



Patient Communication

Make outbound calls to patients as needed

Communicate professionally with patients and families

Follow scripts and practice protocols while sounding natural

Escalate questions or concerns to the appropriate team member

Maintain a positive, patient first tone on all calls



Observation and Follow Up Scheduling

Contact patients who need to schedule follow up appointments

Support observation recall and pending appointment follow up

Speak with patients in a warm, professional, and helpful way

Help patients understand next steps and get scheduled

Document call outcomes and follow up needs accurately



Insurance Verification

Verify dental and orthodontic insurance eligibility and benefits

Confirm coverage, deductibles, maximums, waiting periods, and limitations

Complete accurate insurance breakdowns

Document insurance details clearly in the practice management system

Flag missing, unclear, or incorrect insurance information for follow up



Claims Follow Up

Follow up on unpaid, denied, rejected, or delayed claims

Contact insurance companies as needed to check claim status

Review EOBs and identify payment discrepancies

Document claim updates clearly for the team

Help keep insurance and billing workflows moving accurately



What a star looks like at six months

Here are the three things on your scorecard. Hit these and you're not just doing the job, you're the reason our

days feel the way they do.

1. Every call feels like the best call of the patient's day. Phones are answered quickly and warmly, new

patient inquiries turn into booked first visits, and callers feel heard before they hang up. Families mention

your voice by name, and so do our reviews.

2. The schedule is full, smooth, and honest. Appointments are confirmed, reschedules are handled with a

smile, and missed visits get a friendly follow up. Dr. B's day flows without gaps or chaos, and the team never

wonders what's coming next.

3. You've grown into the insurance side and made us better. After our training, you can explain the basics

of orthodontic benefits to a family in plain words and know exactly when to bring in a teammate. You've also

brought us at least one idea that improved how we answer calls or run the schedule, and we put it in place.



Straight talk, up front

We'd rather you know everything now than be surprised later.



The schedule. This is a full time virtual assistant role, 40 hours a week, working remotely from your own

home office in the Philippines on US Central Time hours to match our Nashville office. That means a night

shift on your end, so this role is for Philippines based candidates who are comfortable working nights. You'll

be a true part of our team, not a faceless voice on a line. Your exact hours: 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Central

Time, Monday through Friday, with a one hour unpaid lunch.



The phone is the job. Much of your day is spent on the phone with patients and insurance companies, both

answering calls and making them. This is not a quiet, heads down,
 only seat. If you would rather avoid

the phone, this isn't the one for you.

Your voice has to come through clearly. You'll need clear, natural, confident spoken English, a quiet

space to work, reliable high speed internet, and a good headset.

We will train you on insurance. You don't need to know it already. You do need to be willing to learn it.

We're new. Some systems are still being built. Some days will be packed and some will be quiet, and

everyone pitches in on whatever needs doing, including the unglamorous stuff.

You'll hear the truth. We'll tell you what's working and what isn't, and we expect the same back.

The pay. $7 to $8 an hour.



How to apply

When you apply, please include one sentence about one time you dealt with an unreasonable or unhappy

person and turned it into a great situation. Write it the way you would say it on the phone, and put it at the very

top of your application message. Without that sentence, we won't be able to consider you.



Please submit the following:

1. A viewable link to your updated resume

2. A short paragraph describing your experience with:

Dental or orthodontic insurance verification

Patient scheduling or phone communication

3. A list of any dental, orthodontic, billing, or phone systems you have used

4. A short voice or video introduction via Vocaroo, Loom, or a similar platform so we can evaluate phone

readiness and communication style



Subject line: Orthodontic VA: Insurance & Scheduling | [Your Full Name]



We can't wait to hear from you

We are seeking a systems-driven, forward-thinking Operations Manager to lead and scale the technological backbone of our real estate business. Rather than maintaining static processes, you will use modern AI tools, API integrations, and workflow automations to reduce manual administrative workload, enforce data accuracy, and ensure leads, agents, and transactions move through our pipeline with speed and precision.



Core Tech Stack Ownership

You will directly oversee, optimize, and integrate:



Follow Up Boss (FUB): Advanced pipeline management, custom fields, tags, smart lists, automations, action plans, and webhook routing.



Ylopo: Lead distribution rules, AI conversational tools (Raiya), dynamic remarketing alignment, and registration sync into FUB.



SISU: Commission tracking, agent production goals, transaction dashboards, lead attribution, and automated pipeline status syncing.



SkySlope (or similar Transaction Management): Compliance checkpoints, document intake, e-signature coordination, and automated closing milestone tracking.



Automation Engines: Make (Integromat), Zapier, native webhooks, and REST APIs.



Key Responsibilities

Ecosystem Integration & Data Syncing: Maintain bidirectional data integrity between Follow Up Boss, Ylopo, SISU, and SkySlope to eliminate duplicate data entry across sales, ops, and accounting.



Workflow Automation Architecture: Design, test, and deploy multi-step automations (via Make, Zapier, or native webhooks) to handle lead routing, speed-to-lead alerts, transaction status updates, and agent notifications.



AI Tooling & Conversational Systems: Optimize Ylopo’s Raiya and integrate external LLM tools (OpenAI API, Claude, custom GPTs) for automated lead nurturing, listing copy generation, call/note summarization, and contract extraction.



Production & Metric Dashboards: Build and maintain automated performance dashboards in SISU, tracking cost-per-lead, conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and individual agent KPIs.



Transaction Pipeline Modernization: Streamline handoffs between sales agents, transaction coordinators, and compliance staff, using automation to trigger document requests, deadline alerts, and closing milestones in SkySlope.



Team Training & Change Management: Create concise SOPs, Loom walkthroughs, and technical documentation; lead regular onboarding and training sessions so agents and administrative staff utilize the stack to its full potential.



Core Qualifications

Direct System Mastery: Hands-on operational experience configuring and managing Follow Up Boss, Ylopo, and SISU. Familiarity with SkySlope (or Dotloop) is strongly preferred.



Real Estate Operations Background: 3+ years in operations management, systems administration, or BizOps within a high-producing real estate team, brokerage, or tech-enabled real estate firm.



Integration Expertise: Proven track record building and troubleshooting complex scenarios on Make (Integromat) or Zapier using webhooks, filters, iterators, routers, and JSON payloads.



Applied AI Experience: Practical understanding of prompt engineering, AI document processing, and embedding conversational AI tools into everyday operational workflows.



Process Mapping & Problem-Solving: Ability to deconstruct a manual, multi-person real estate workflow into an efficient, documented automated pipeline.



Clear Communication: Excellent ability to teach technical workflows to non-technical sales agents and hold the team accountable to data hygiene.

6. Apply feedback consistently without repeated reminders.



We’ll have onboarding calls to establish the style and workflow. After that, you’re expected to manage your responsibilities independently.



WAGE/SALARY:

Starting at $800 USD per month, with opportunities for pay increases up to $1250+ based on performance, results, and growth of the YouTube channel.

title: Platform Tester (H-1B / PERM) — USImmigration.ai
description:
About the role



USImmigration.ai is looking for a contract Platform Tester with deep, hands-on H-1B and PERM experience to help us build out and test the H-1B and PERM functionality of our platform.



USImmigration.ai is a case management and AI intake/retainer platform built for U.S. immigration law firms. 

We are expanding the platform to fully support H-1B (including LCA) and EB-2/EB-3 PERM cases. 

We have two testers already; neither has H-1B or PERM experience. You would be our subject-matter expert for these case types.

This is not a click-through QA role. You will test what the platform produces against what an experienced H-1B/PERM paralegal or attorney would expect, and you will tell our developers how the platform should work: what screens, fields, workflows, and documents are needed to run these cases well. Your input will shape the product directly, including upcoming DOL-related workflows and integrations. 

Final legal interpretations and compliance-sensitive requirements will be reviewed and approved by qualified U.S. immigration counsel.



What you'll do

Test the platform's H-1B and PERM outputs

Run full H-1B and PERM cases through the platform using fictional/synthetic case data and documents that you build to mirror real-world scenarios (change of status, cap-subject, cap-exempt, amendments, transfers, extensions; PERM with and without special recruitment, professional vs. non-professional, audit scenarios)

Review every output the platform generates (questionnaires, forms, LCA and ETA-9089 data, support letters, recruitment summaries, checklists, deadline calculations) for accuracy, completeness, and consistency with how an experienced practitioner would prepare the case

Evaluate the compliance workflows around the case, not just the filings: for H-1B, LCA posting and public access file requirements, wage obligations, material-change and amendment triggers, and filing deadlines; for PERM, prevailing wage, recruitment documentation, supervised recruitment, audit file retention, and filing deadlines

Log clear, reproducible bug reports and accuracy issues, ranked by severity, with screenshots and the expected result

Re-test fixes and confirm they are correct before they ship

Design how the platform should work

Write product requirements for H-1B and PERM features: case workflows, intake questionnaires, required fields, document checklists, deadline rules, and status stages

Propose screen layouts, field groupings, and navigation that make the platform fast and intuitive for paralegals and attorneys who run high volumes of these cases

Compare our platform against the leading immigration case management software you have used and identify what we are missing or doing worse

Help define Phase 2 scope, including DOL-related workflows and potential integrations (FLAG/LCA preparation and filing support, PERM preparation and audit tracking, prevailing wage), USCIS case status tracking, and recruitment management, subject to technical feasibility and applicable system access requirements

Review developer mockups and builds and give direct written feedback before and after implementation

Work with the team

Join regular calls with the founders and the development team

Keep a running test plan and feature backlog for H-1B and PERM

Coordinate with our two existing testers so coverage and reporting are consistent across case types



What we're looking for

Required

5+ years of hands-on H-1B and PERM case work at a U.S. immigration law firm or corporate immigration team, start to finish: LCA preparation, certification, and public access files; H-1B petition assembly (I-129, H Supplement, support letters, RFE responses) and amendment analysis; prevailing wage determinations; PERM recruitment and recruitment documentation, including supervised recruitment; ETA-9089 preparation; and audit file preparation and responses



Substantial daily use (3+ years preferred) of a sophisticated immigration case management platform with strong H-1B/PERM workflows (for example INSZoom, LawLogix Guardian, Docketwise, Cerenade eIMMIGRATION, or a comparable system), including questionnaires, form generation, document assembly, and deadline tracking



Able to look at a form, letter, or data output and spot what is wrong, missing, or risky



Able to write clear product requirements and feature proposals: you can describe what a screen or workflow should do, why, and how a paralegal would use it



Strong written English and comfortable giving direct feedback to developers



Based in the Philippines and available to work as an independent contractor with at least 4 hours of overlap with U.S. Pacific time



Nice to have



Experience with other employment-based categories (EB-1, EB-2 NIW, L-1, O-1, TN, E-2)

Prior QA, UAT, or product/implementation work on a legal or SaaS platform (writing test plans, bug tracking, acceptance testing)

Familiarity with DOL FLAG, iCERT history, and USCIS online filing systems

Experience configuring or administering a case management platform (templates, workflows, custom fields)

Basic familiarity with tools like Jira, Trello, Notion, Loom, or Figma





Confidentiality and test data. 

You will sign a confidentiality agreement. 

Testing uses only fictional/synthetic case files, company-provided data, or public materials.

Real client materials from any current or former employer may not be used in any form, including redacted, and doing so is grounds for immediate termination.



Equipment. You will need a reliable computer, stable internet, and a quiet place to take video calls.

USImmigration.ai Inc. is a California corporation based in Woodland Hills, CA.

title: Senior Loan Processor
description:
About DreamPoint Capital

DreamPoint Capital is a private real estate lending brokerage specializing in DSCR (debt service coverage ratio) loans, residential transition loans (RTL/fix-and-flip), bridge financing, and commercial loan placements for real estate investors across the United States. We work with a deep network of institutional and private capital lenders to match borrowers with the right loan program and close transactions quickly.

We're a lean, technology-forward team. Our reps use proprietary AI-powered scenario matching, an AI receptionist, and modern loan workflow tooling — we expect our processors to be comfortable in that environment and contribute to making it better.



The Role

We're hiring an experienced loan processor to own files from submission through funding. You'll be the operational backbone between our reps, borrowers, and lenders — collecting conditions, structuring deals correctly the first time, and pushing files to close on tight investor timelines.

This is not an entry-level role. We need someone who can read a tri-merge, spot a DSCR shortfall, anticipate what a lender will ask for before they ask, and run multiple files in parallel without dropping balls.

What you'll do



Manage a pipeline of 15–25+ active DSCR, RTL, and bridge loan files concurrently from intake through funding

Review borrower intake packages for completeness — entity docs, credit, liquidity, experience, schedule of real estate owned, lease agreements, rent rolls, purchase contracts, rehab budgets, insurance binders

Order and review third-party reports: appraisals, BPOs, title commitments, flood certs, payoff statements, HOA estoppels

Calculate and verify DSCR, LTV, LTC, ARV, and debt yield against each lender's specific guideline matrix

Coordinate with title companies, attorneys, insurance agents, and lender underwriters to clear conditions

Prep clean submission packages and respond to lender conditions with precision and speed

Track every file in our loan management system; keep status notes current so reps and borrowers always know where things stand

Review closing disclosures and settlement statements for accuracy before close

Flag deal-killers early — title issues, appraisal gaps, entity structure problems, seasoning issues, recognition agreement requirements on co-op collateral

Contribute to process improvement — if a workflow is broken, you tell us and help fix it



What you need



5+ years of loan processing experience, with at least 2 years in non-QM, DSCR, fix-and-flip, bridge, or commercial real estate lending (this is non-negotiable — conventional/agency-only experience is not a fit)

Working knowledge of US private lending guidelines from at least a few of: Kiavi, Lima One, RCN, Roc Capital, Velocity, Visio, Constructive, LendingOne, Builders Capital, or similar

Comfort with entity-titled loans (LLC, LP, corporation), personal guarantees, and the documentation that comes with them

Sharp Excel skills — you can build a quick DSCR calc, reconcile a settlement statement, and audit a rent roll without complaint

Excellent written English — you will be in direct email and Slack contact with US-based lenders, attorneys, and borrowers

Strong reading comprehension for legal and financial documents — title commitments, operating agreements, leases, purchase contracts

Self-directed work style; you don't need someone standing over you to hit deadlines

Reliable home office: stable high-speed internet, quiet environment, backup power, modern computer

Available for at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern time daily



Nice to have



Experience with co-op collateral, ground leases, or other complex collateral structures

Familiarity with TRID, RESPA, and basic compliance frameworks (even though most of our products are business-purpose and exempt)

Prior experience at a US-based lender, broker, or BPO supporting US lending operations

Comfort with modern tools: Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, AI tools (ChatGPT/Claude), and willingness to learn our internal apps

Exposure to title work, escrow coordination, or insurance review



What we offer



Competitive USD-denominated salary commensurate with experience (target range disclosed in first interview)

Performance bonuses tied to closed loan volume and file cycle time

Paid time off and Philippine holidays observed

Equipment stipend

Direct access to founder and senior team — your work has visible impact on the business

Growth path into senior operations, team lead, or underwriting roles as we scale



How to apply

Send a resume and a brief cover note describing the most complex loan file you've ever processed — what made it hard, and how you got it closed — to 
]. Please include "Senior Loan Processor — [Your Name]" in the subject line.

Candidates who pass initial screen will complete a paid case study using a real (anonymized) DSCR scenario before any final interviews.
