title: Personal Executive Assistant
description:
# HIRING: Proactive Personal Executive Assistant | ADHD Accountability & Life Management | Paid Trial



**Pay:** $5–$6 USD/hour  

**Hours:** 15 hours/week  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00–11:00 AM US Eastern Time  

**Location:** Remote — Philippines  

**Employment Type:** Initial 30-Day Paid Trial  

**Opportunity:** Potential long-term position with increased hours and responsibilities based on performance and business growth



## About the Role



I'm a US-based entrepreneur and father managing multiple business ventures, professional responsibilities, personal goals, and family commitments.



I'm looking for an exceptional Personal Executive Assistant who can help bring structure, consistency, and organization to my daily life while helping me become more productive and effective in my businesses.



I have ADHD and work best with someone who understands executive-function challenges, proactive accountability, and how to turn ideas into actionable steps.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant position where you simply wait for instructions.



I need someone who anticipates needs, organizes responsibilities, identifies problems, takes initiative, and helps ensure important things actually get completed.



**This position will begin as a 30-day paid trial.** My intention is to build a long-term working relationship, but I want to ensure we are a great fit and that the role creates measurable value before extending our arrangement.



A major objective is to free up my time and improve my follow-through so I can focus on revenue-generating activities. As my businesses grow and the value of this partnership becomes clear, there may be opportunities for continued employment, increased hours, and expanded responsibilities.



## Your Primary Responsibilities



### 1. Daily Planning & ADHD Accountability



- Help structure my day around clear, realistic priorities.

- Conduct morning planning and accountability check-ins.

- Break overwhelming projects into manageable next steps.

- Track deadlines, commitments, and unfinished tasks.

- Proactively follow up when something needs attention.

- Help me stay focused without micromanaging.

- Adapt communication methods based on what works best.

- Maintain a simple, effective task-management system.



### 2. Personal & Family Life Management



- Organize personal and family calendars.

- Coordinate appointments, school-related activities, and household responsibilities.

- Research and arrange travel, activities, and services.

- Track important documents, bills, renewals, and deadlines.

- Help organize personal goals, routines, and life projects.

- Anticipate upcoming responsibilities and prepare reminders or action plans.



### 3. Communication & Administrative Support



- Organize and manage
 inboxes.

- Draft responses and handle approved routine communications.

- Follow up with contacts, clients, and service providers.

- Schedule meetings, calls, and appointments.

- Maintain organized files and records.

- Track outstanding responses and important conversations.

- Ensure important messages and opportunities do not get overlooked.



### 4. Executive & Business Support



- Help organize multiple entrepreneurial projects.

- Track business commitments, meetings, and follow-ups.

- Research services, opportunities, and solutions.

- Coordinate routine administrative tasks.

- Convert ideas into organized action plans.

- Track potential revenue opportunities and important client follow-ups.

- Help ensure revenue-generating tasks receive appropriate priority.

- Provide concise updates on completed work and pending decisions.



## Who I'm Looking For



You are someone who naturally creates order out of chaos.



You are proactive, dependable, resourceful, organized, emotionally intelligent, and comfortable working with a creative entrepreneur who has multiple competing priorities.



**Required Qualifications**



- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Proven experience as a virtual assistant, personal assistant, or executive assistant.

- Strong calendar,
, scheduling, and task-management skills.

- Excellent follow-through and attention to detail.

- Ability to prioritize without constant supervision.

- Comfortable making routine decisions within established boundaries.

- Strong problem-solving and research abilities.

- Able to work reliably during US Eastern morning hours.

- Comfortable handling confidential information professionally.

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet environment for calls.



**Strongly Preferred**



- Previous experience supporting an entrepreneur or executive with ADHD.

- Familiarity with executive dysfunction, task initiation, and accountability techniques.

- Experience creating simple organizational systems.

- Experience with Google Workspace, Notion, ClickUp, Asana, or similar tools.

- Experience supporting both personal and business responsibilities.

- Experience tracking client follow-ups, business opportunities, or revenue-related tasks.



## Personality Matters



I'm looking for someone who is:



- Calm and patient, but assertive when necessary.

- Comfortable respectfully holding me accountable.

- Independent and solution-oriented.

- Adaptable to different communication styles.

- Comfortable asking thoughtful questions.

- Naturally proactive rather than reactive.

- Interested in building a long-term professional relationship.



I don't need someone who agrees with everything I say. I value thoughtful feedback, initiative, and someone who can respectfully tell me when something important needs attention.



## The 30-Day Trial & Performance Expectations



The first 30 days will be a paid evaluation period for both of us.



During this time, we will focus on:



1. **Organization:** Establishing a reliable system for my daily tasks, calendar, deadlines, and responsibilities.

2. **Accountability:** Improving my consistency in completing important personal and business tasks.

3. **Time Savings:** Reducing the amount of time I spend on administrative work.

4. **Communication:** Ensuring important
s, messages, appointments, and follow-ups are handled consistently.

5. **Business Productivity:** Helping me stay focused on income-generating opportunities and preventing important business follow-ups from falling through the cracks.



We will conduct brief weekly performance reviews to discuss what is working, what needs improvement, and how we can make our collaboration more effective.



**Continuation beyond the initial trial is not guaranteed.** It will depend on performance, mutual fit, available business resources, and the measurable value the role creates.



My goal is to build a sustainable partnership where your support helps me operate more efficiently, generate more income, and create opportunities for both of us to grow professionally.



## What Success Looks Like



By the end of the trial, I want to see:



- A simple organizational system that I actually use.

- A consistent morning planning and accountability routine.

- Better management of appointments, deadlines, and communications.

- Fewer unfinished or forgotten administrative tasks.

- More time available for business development and income-generating work.

- Clear evidence that the partnership is making my daily life and businesses run more smoothly.



You will have freedom to improve processes and recommend better ways of working while respecting established approval boundaries.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction describing your executive or personal assistant experience.

2. Your experience supporting entrepreneurs or executives with ADHD, if applicable.

3. An example of a system you created to improve a client's organization or productivity.

4. How you would help a client who has five important tasks but struggles to get started.

5. Your experience with Google Workspace and productivity tools.

6. Your availability during US Eastern morning hours.

7. Your desired hourly rate within the advertised range.

8. How you would help an entrepreneur become more productive and stay focused on revenue-generating activities.



**Important:** Begin your application with the words **"Proactive Partner"** so I know you read the entire posting.



I'm looking for someone who wants to prove their value, build trust, and potentially grow into a long-term executive support position.



If you enjoy solving problems, creating systems, and helping ambitious people follow through on their goals, I'd love to hear from you.

About Us



Started in 2017, and we're growing like crazy.

We expect to hire at least 4 salespeople, 3 admins, and 3 marketers in 2026.

Growing FAST - We sold 2663 lessons in 2025, and we're on pace to sell 3328 lessons in 2026.

We sell manual transmission driving lessons in the United States. Yes, really.

100% inbound leads from Organic Search (SEO). We don’t do cold calling.

Type of Employment

Full Time

40 hours per week

Schedule - 9 AM to 5 PM EST





Compensation and Benefits

Competitive commission package - $4.00 per hour



Benefits to be provided after completion of 3 months:

Health Insurance





Entry Level Details

Note that this is an entry-level job.

We do NOT expect you to have any prior admin experience.

If you’re looking to switch careers and get your foot in the door, this could be great for you.

This is a great opportunity for anyone with a background in any of the following areas: Customer Service, VA Admin, Admin Data Processing, Clerk,
 Communications, General VA, Admin Support, Sales and Admin Specialist, Administrative Support, Operations Admin, Executive Admin Assistant, Sales Assistant.





Duties and Responsibilities

New Orders - Processing Product Order (Gift Certificate)

New Orders - Initial Order Confirmation (Level 3)

Instructor Onboarding, Offboarding and Reonboarding

Reactivate Unavailable Instructor

Secret Message: When you apply, under the section that says "Is there anything else you'd like to write or include?", write the word PINK ELEPHANT. This will show us that you read the entire job description.

Duplicate Record Check

Updating the "Daily Tracking" Process

CTM Prospect Staging





Qualifications

At least 2-3 years of minimum work experience in a relevant or equivalent role

Comprehensive background in Customer and Administrative support

High level of accuracy and attention to detail

Excellent English communication and comprehension

Proficiency in using and managing Google applications - Gmail, Calendar, Documents, Drive

Preferably with knowledge in using cloud-based CRM

Organized and has careful attention to detail

Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively

Strong Problem-Solving skills

Customer Service Oriented and the ability to adapt/respond properly to different types of scenarios

Equipped with good skills in office/admin management, and can suggest process improvements

Must have your own computer, reliable high-speed internet, and a good quality headset and microphone.





What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experience lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINK ELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.

title: Sales VA (Text & Follow-Ups) – $5/hr + Weekly Team Bonus
description:
NON-VOICE SALES VA – TEXT & FOLLOW-UPS (REMOTE, FULL TIME)

Wheels, Tires & Accessories



ABOUT US

We're a fast-growing online wheels and tires retailer built around lease-to-own and installment financing. We help customers across the US get the setup they want on their vehicle today and pay over time. Almost all of our sales happen by text.

We're hiring a sales VA to own our text conversations with customers. This is a non-voice role: no phone calls and no cold outreach. Every conversation is inbound or a warm follow-up.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Reply to customer texts about products, fitment, financing, and orders

• Follow up with customers who applied for financing: approved but not checked out, abandoned carts, and denied applications

• Help customers find wheels and tires that fit their vehicle using our fitment tools (no car knowledge needed)

• Create invoices and send order confirmation texts

• Flag anything that needs attention so nothing falls through the cracks



HOW THE WORK GETS DONE

Most of our process is automated. AI drafts most messages from our prompts and guidelines, and our SOPs, scripts, and paste-ins cover almost every situation.

Your job is to read carefully, check the AI's work, catch what's wrong, and d
 what happens next. We care more about clear thinking than years of experience.



PAY

• $5.00/hr base, full time (45-50 hours a week)

• Weekly team bonus: once the store passes 15 orders in a week, you earn an extra $10 for every 5 orders above that (20 orders = +$10, 25 = +$20, 30 = +$30, no cap). The whole team earns it together.

• Paid every Friday, on time, every week

• Pay and bonuses are reviewed as we grow



SCHEDULE

• Monday to Friday, 9 AM–5 PM EST 

• Saturday and Sunday, 9 AM–2 PM EST 

•Looking for flexibility, able to step in if needed. And reliability, showing up. 

As we grow, we plan to stagger sales shifts so someone covers 12 PM–8 PM EST.

There would be one off day a week. 



TOOLS

• Quo (formerly OpenPhone) for texting

• Shopify for orders and customer details

• Lender portals for approval statuses

• AI fitment and messaging tools

• Our website's product pages, cart, and checkout

Full training on every tool, so no prior experience is needed.



WHAT'S NOT YOUR JOB

Cancellations, refunds, and damage claims go to our customer service, and orders are placed by operations. Financing account problems go to the lender, and if a customer needs a call, like an unanswered fitment follow-up, our sales manager makes it. Every script includes the right escalation path, so you'll always know where to send something.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Clear, warm, professional written English. Our customers are everyday Americans texting from their phones.

• A careful reader who follows the SOP instead of guessing and asks when unsure. To show us you read the whole post, start your application with the word LUGNUT.

• Self-directed: you manage your own queue and stay on top of follow-ups without reminders.

• Coachable: you take feedback and actually apply it.

• Reliable: you show up for every shift and never leave a customer hanging.

Sales or chat support experience is a plus, not a requirement.



HOW YOU'LL RAMP UP

Training happens over 
, calls, and text, so you'll always have a direct line for questions and real-time feedback.

• Week 1: Learn the SOPs, tools, and scripts, and shadow real conversations.

• Week 2: Handle inbound texts, with your replies reviewed and feedback given.

• Week 3+: Take on the full follow-up queue once you're accurate and consistent.

Every conversation is reviewed daily and weekly. The feedback is there to help you improve, not just to catch mistakes.



GROWTH

Our sales manager started as our first sales VA. We promote from within, and reliable people who show leadership are first in line for senior and lead roles.



HOW TO APPLY

Include all of these:

1. A 60-second video introducing yourself in English: your background and what being reliable means to you in remote work. No script needed. Share a Loom, unlisted YouTube, or Google Drive link.

2. A few sentences on what you're looking for long-term. We're not hiring for a short contract or side gig. We want someone who wants to grow with us.

3. Which shift you'd prefer: 9 AM–5 PM EST, or 12 PM–8 PM EST once it opens.

Applications missing the video won't be reviewed.

All texts and calls on the store line are recorded for training and quality. By applying, you acknowledge that all communications on the store line are monitored.
